# About 2022 Mural Fest

About 2022 Mural Fest

## About

Kentish Arts Commerce and Tourism is excited to announce Mural Fest will be taking place between Monday 7th November and Friday 11th November 2022.

This year nine artists from around Tasmania will be selected to paint a mural over a five-day period based on the theme ‘The Place I Call Home’. Two prizes will be awarded, The People’s Choice Award ($7000) and the Highly Commended Award ($2000). These murals will remain on display in Mural Park for eleven months until the murals are relocated to the towns they represent, forming Kentish Arts Commerce and Tourism’s newest initiative, the ‘Tasmanian Mural Trail’. This unique mural trail will begin and end in Sheffield and will showcase the special characteristics that towns around Tasmania call their own.

Tasmanian councils and arts groups are encouraged to seek out and sponsor an artist to paint a mural representing their town or region at Mural Fest, a mural which will find its home in the town it represents and will form part of the ‘Tasmanian Mural Trail’.

Inspiration for the artwork can be drawn from regional and rural Tasmania whether it is the physical or human characteristics of a place (landscapes, flora, fauna), the human characteristics such as culture, the built environment, or industries rich in history such as produce, wine, agriculture, and fishing. Identifying emotive bonds and attachments to ‘The Place I Call Home’ will provide towns in Tasmania with their own beautiful mural to take pride of place for the local community and visiting public to enjoy.

Mural Fest is committed to creating an annual event which contributes to the unique interest of the ‘Town of Murals’ by providing emerging and established artists with an opportunity to showcase their talents in a public forum, assisting in their artistic growth and development, and promoting mural art as a valued art form.

International Mural Fest, a prestigious event on the international arts calendar will take place in 2023 as part of the 20th year anniversary celebrations.

## Are you ready for a weekend of cool culture?

GreazeFest is the ultimate rockabilly and hot rod weekend in Australia, where thousands of passionate people come together for an action-packed weekend of cool culture.

GreazeFest is a gathering of cool cars, rockabilly bands, DJs, pinups, vintage bikes, kustom art shows and competitions, pinstripers, markets, and heaps more.

Treat yourself to a day out or a full weekend at GreazeFest, and soak up the atmosphere, catch incredible live music, and experience the energy of the rockabilly and hot rod scene.

* * *

## GreazeFest 2027 dates:

*   Friday July 30   
    \- 7pm to midnight
*   Saturday July 31 - Day Events   
    \- 10am to 5pm
*   Saturday July 31 - Night Events   
    \- 5pm to 10pm
*   Sunday August 1   
    \- 9am to 6pm

All events are held at: Redland Showgrounds, Cleveland, Qld

### Art Show Update

On October 1, 2026, we made the $1,200 donation to the RSPCA from our annual GreazeFest Art Show - and it turned into $2,400!

For that day only, all donations were being matched by the RSPCA’s corporate partners as part of their Give to Get Them Home campaign, which means our GreazeFest donation has doubled in value!

Thank you to all of our amazing artists at GreazeFest and to everyone who purchased artwork and helped make this donation possible.

# Rip Curl International Surf Team

##### A Rip Curl athlete is much more than a brand ambassador. Since the beginning, Rip Curl has strived for nothing short of the best – the World’s Ultimate Surf, Snow and Wake teams. Rip Curl athletes are World Champions. They are innovators, dreamers, role models and Searchers.

From global elite athletes to regional rising talents, no matter where you are in the world, the best surfers, snowboarders, skiers and wakeboards will be riding with a Rip Curl sticker on the nose of their board.

### THE GREATEST WOMEN’S SURFER OF ALL TIME. WITH 8 WORLD TITLES, SHE SITS ALONE AT THE TOP OF THE SPORT.

After bursting onto the scene in 2005 with a CT win as a wildcard, Steph qualified for the 2007 World Tour and won the next 4 World Titles, becoming the only surfer in history to win in their ‘rookie’ season. Adding 4 more titles, Steph is widely celebrated as a sporting icon, possessing amazing style, skill, and power in the water, along with a genuine and engaging personality on land. Through her career she has defined surfing at the elite level and inspired every surfer on the planet.

Mick Fanning

![Mick Fanning](//www.ripcurl.co.id/cdn/shop/files/Team_Rider_Landing_Page_MickFanning_V2.jpg?v=1774951573&width=1200)

### MICK FANNING IS AN AUSSIE HERO. MICK FANNING IS A LEGEND. AND RIGHT NOW, AFTER RETIRING FROM THE WORLD TOUR IN 2018, MICK FANNING IS OFFICIALLY ON THE SEARCH.

It’s difficult to sum up a man like Mick Fanning in just a few short sentences. A surfer? Yes. A brother, a son? A 3x World Champion? One of our sport’s greatest athletes? Yes. Yes. Yes. The unlucky surfer who got knocked off his board by a white pointer during a Final at Jeffrey’s Bay, broadcast live around the world? Yes.

[Learn More](https://www.ripcurl.co.id/pages/mick-fanning)

Tom Curren

![Tom Curren](//www.ripcurl.co.id/cdn/shop/files/Team_Rider_Landing_Page_TomCurren5.jpg?v=1774951627&width=1200)

### TOM CURREN IS, WITHOUT A DOUBT, ONE OF THE GREATEST SURFERS OF ALL TIME.

A true Californian, Tom grew up surfing the long walls of Rincon in Santa Barbara, and developed a smooth, sweeping style that trademarks his career in surf.  
  
Tom is much more than a 3x World Champion, he was one of the pioneers of progressive competitive surfing. He was one of the original Searchers, travelling to the ends of the earth on a mission to find perfect, un-surfed waves. Enigmatic, slightly reclusive and incredibly eccentric, Tom is a legend and holds an almost mythical presence in surfing history.

[Learn More](https://www.ripcurl.co.id/pages/tom-curren)

Mason Ho

![Mason Ho](//www.ripcurl.co.id/cdn/shop/files/Team_Rider_Landing_Page_MasonHo4.jpg?v=1774839166&width=1200)

### OFTEN REFERRED TO AS THE BIGGEST PERSONALITY IN SURFING, MASON HO IS A ONE-OF-A-KIND HUMAN.

Son to legendary Michael Ho, nephew to World Champion Derek Ho, brother to World Tour athlete Coco Ho… Mase comes from a long line of Hawaiian surfing legends, and he’s done his best to follow in their footsteps.  

[Learn More](https://www.ripcurl.co.id/pages/mason-ho)

Molly Picklum

![Molly Picklum](//www.ripcurl.co.id/cdn/shop/files/Team_Rider_Landing_Page_MollyPicklum_WorldChampTrophy.jpg?v=1774948336&width=1200)

### AT 22, SHE HAS WON HER FIRST WORLD TITLE AT THE 2025 WSL FINALS.

A teenage surf prodigy, Molly Picklum's trophy cabinet is filling up rapidly, despite the Australian's career having only just begun.  
  
There are few surfers in Australia who've garnered as much recognition as Molly Picklum over the last few years. And for good reason. At just 18-years-old, Molly already has two back-to-back Australian Championships titles to her name, won the Australian Pro Junior in 2019 and was also named Female Rising Star at the Australian Surfing Awards in 2020.

[Learn More](https://www.ripcurl.co.id/pages/molly-picklum)

Owen Wright

![Owen Wright](//www.ripcurl.co.id/cdn/shop/files/owne-headshot.jpg?v=1774951875&width=1200)

### THE SECOND ELDEST OF THE WRIGHT CLAN, OWEN GREW UP IN A SMALL TOWN ON THE SOUTH COAST OF NSW, SPENDING AS MUCH TIME AS POSSIBLE IN THE WATER.

From a young age he was poised to become a professional surfer – his tall and powerful frame an asset to his surfing, his love for the ocean and thirst for adrenaline pushing his skills to new limits.  
  
In 2010 Owen cracked the QS and entered the elite ranks of the World Tour, leading by example for his younger sister Tyler. More than anything in the world, Owen loves getting barrelled – and will push his limits to do so.

[Learn More](https://www.ripcurl.co.id/pages/owen-wright)

Morgan Cibilic

![Morgan Cibilic](//www.ripcurl.co.id/cdn/shop/files/25_Solomons_MCC_SGN_6923_3810f3ff-1e9c-4b50-94c2-9b616fc5088a.jpg?v=1774839360&width=1200)

### MORGAN CIBILIC IS THE CURRENT ROOKIE OF THE YEAR RESULT FOR 2021 SEASON. HE WAS A COMPETITOR ON THE 2021 WSL CT NOW AFTER HIS RIP CURL WSL FINALS APPEARANCE.

Morgan Cibilic is known for his smooth, fast and powerful style. Morgs generates speed off the bottom where others can't and drives into critical sections with abandon. He spent his time growing up between the surfing hubs of Angourie and Merewether.

[Learn More](https://www.ripcurl.co.id/pages/morgan-cibilic)

Crosby Colapinto

![Crosby Colapinto](//www.ripcurl.co.id/cdn/shop/files/Team_Rider_Landing_Page_CrosbyColapinto13.jpg?v=1774958374&width=1200)

### CROSBY IS THE FULL PACKAGE. HE’S FUNNY YET HUMBLE, CAN THROW HUGE AIRS, WEAVE INCREDIBLE TUBES AND LAY DOWN PROPER MAN HACKS.

It’s no wonder he was able to bring his childhood dream to life, making the World Tour in 2024 as a part of the 2% Crew from San Clemente, California.  
  
‘The Croz’ grew up honing his freakish surfing abilities at his home break of Trestles, among that hotbed of talent (including his older brother Griffin). Crosby is his own man though, and his own surfer, ready to take on the world with a unique combination of power, excitement and grace.

[Learn More](https://www.ripcurl.co.id/pages/crosby-colapinto)

Samuel Pupo

![Samuel Pupo](//www.ripcurl.co.id/cdn/shop/files/24_Brazil_SPO_MAA_N6A9168-600x400-20d471b.jpg?v=1774958536&width=1200)

### SURFING IS IN SAMMY PUPO’S BLOOD. BETTER KNOWN AS SAMUCA IN BRAZIL, HE’S THE SON OF NATIONAL SURFING ICON WAGNER AND BROTHER OF WSL COMPETITOR MIGUEL.

Sammy started riding waves at the age of three and was competing at the age of five. He won Kelly Slater’s Young Guns wavepool event in 2018, took out his first Qualifying Series win at the EDP Billabong Pro Ericeira in 2019, and clinched Rookie of the Year in 2022, finishing top 10 during his first year on the World Tour.

[Learn More](https://www.ripcurl.co.id/pages/samuel-pupo)

Jacob Willcox

Jacob ‘Chippo’ Willcox surfs better than anyone you know. He spent his grom years alternating between nailing event wins and enjoying surf holidays with his beloved family in Western Australia.

Erin Brooks

# Exhibit & Sponsor

## GET IN FRONT OF REAL TATTOO FANS AND THE ARTISTS THEY FOLLOW

Whether you're here to sell, connect, or make a statement, we offer powerful opportunities to get you noticed from premium booth spaces to creative, high-impact sponsorship activations.

[Book a Booth](https://www.austattooexpo.com.au/exhibit-sponsor#Apply-Now)

![Live talk at australian tattoo expo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67d91517fc266b27ebfc2fa8/6813372369d3798df6588955_booths_at_rop-2.jpg)

Book a Booth

## Exhibit & Sponsor

Join a 3-day celebration of tattoo artistry and culture, bringing together local and global artists, studios, and the latest industry innovations.

![Global Artists Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67d91517fc266b27ebfc2fa8/68d9cd8c15e660c75b5b96ac_global-artists-yellow-chrome.webp)

### Artists

#### INK. CONNECT. GROW.

Planning on joining this massive meetup? Confirm your booth today.

[Book a Booth](https://www.austattooexpo.com.au/enquiry/artist)

![Vendor Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67d91517fc266b27ebfc2fa8/68ae5967bd348131b82e2084_vendor-chrome.webp)

### Vendors

#### REACH 30,000+ TATTOO FANS

Your customers are here. Let’s put you in front of them.

[Partner With Us](https://www.austattooexpo.com.au/enquiry/retailer)

![Sponsor Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67d91517fc266b27ebfc2fa8/68ae5877101c2a4a5b3bc60e_sponsor-chrome.webp)

### Sponsors

#### FACE-TO-FACE WITH THE RIGHT CROWD

Alongside the makers, right where your brand belongs.

[Sponsor The Expo](https://www.austattooexpo.com.au/enquiry/sponsorship-enquiry)

## Benefits of exhibiting

The Tattoo Expo brings together every corner of the culture. These are the people you’ll connect with and the opportunities they’re looking for.

[Apply Now](https://www.austattooexpo.com.au/exhibit-sponsor#Apply-Now)

![Tattoo Culture Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67d91517fc266b27ebfc2fa8/68b3e1b8e0ae8eda7a981e7f_culture-chrome.webp)

### Put Your Brand Where Culture Lives

Let’s build something unforgettable and put your brand where the culture lives.

![Tattoo Industry Leaders Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67d91517fc266b27ebfc2fa8/68b3e1b983d729459cef7cd1_industry-chrome.webp)

### Connect With Industry Leaders

Connect with leading industry tattoo artists who set trends and styles across the global tattoo community.

![Tattoo Expo Audience Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67d91517fc266b27ebfc2fa8/68b3e1b92b14523000e7ac78_audience-chrome.webp)

### Reach the Biggest Audience

Highest concentration of tattoo collectors and enthusiasts of any industry event.

![Tattoo Clients Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67d91517fc266b27ebfc2fa8/68b3f2561568ffba5defc0f7_clients-chrome.webp)

### Generate Real Clients

Generate qualified clients from serious collectors and first-timers who are actively seeking unique designs and artists.

Tickets included for your team to access all special networking events, live demonstrations, pre-party and more.

[

](https://www.austattooexpo.com.au/exhibit-sponsor#)

## Who You'll Meet

The Tattoo Expo brings together every corner of the culture. These are the people you’ll connect with and the opportunities they’re looking for.

[Apply Now](https://www.austattooexpo.com.au/exhibit-sponsor#Apply-Now)

![Global Artists Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67d91517fc266b27ebfc2fa8/68abf20dafd1ee041c67aa61_global-artists-orange-chrome.webp)

### The Masters

Celebrated artists from around the world, here to showcase their craft and inspire. They’re looking for collaborations, fresh ideas, and brands that match their creativity.

![The Creators Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67d91517fc266b27ebfc2fa8/68ae42388fe5cb2c6d495cd7_creators-chrome.webp)

### The Creators

Studio owners and industry leaders who keep tattoo culture alive. They’re sourcing new equipment, supplies, and partnerships to grow their businesses and stay ahead.

![The Collectors Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67d91517fc266b27ebfc2fa8/68ae4603bd7a3286b18867bc_collectors-heart-chrome.webp)

### The Collectors

Dedicated tattoo enthusiasts investing in meaningful pieces. They want quality, unique designs, and connections with artists and brands that match their passion.

![The Newcomers Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67d91517fc266b27ebfc2fa8/68ae42385a3cc059a9eb6615_newcomers-chrome.webp)

### The Newcomers

People stepping into tattoo culture for the first time. They’re looking for guidance, trusted artists, and products that make their first tattoo experience unforgettable.

### "I met so many new clients and collectors in one weekend. I left with bookings, new collectors interested in my work, and even a couple of collaborations lined up."

![Alan Truong Black Jade Tattoo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67d91517fc266b27ebfc2fa8/68ae2e55454e6372e1170c0e_67d91517fc266b27ebfc2fde_445740630_372958065754955_1425667969680701249_n.jpg)

Alan Truong

Black Jade Tattoo

## How it works

Step 1

### Apply online

Send us your details to express your interest. It only takes a minute.  

Step 2

### Lock In youR Spot

We give you a call, make sure this is for you. Choose your booth.

Step 3

### Showcase your brand

Set up shop at the Expo. Exhibit to thousands of tattoo lovers.

## EVERYTHING YOU GET

The Tattoo Expo brings together every corner of the culture. These are the people you’ll connect with and the opportunities they’re looking for.

[Apply Now](https://www.austattooexpo.com.au/exhibit-sponsor#Apply-Now)

### Pre event

**Simple 3-step set-up**  
Work directly with our world-class booth supplier to customise your booth and exhibit with ease.

**Become an official exhibitor**  
List your studio or brand in the Exhibitor Page on the official website, viewed by thousands from the tattoo community.

**Increase your brand reach**  
Feature your company logo among exhibitors in social media and email announcements to all attendee

**Pre-event party**  
Gain access to a private networking evening with peers and industry insiders.

### EVENT DAY

**Stand Out**  
Collect leads and form partnerships from a space that works as hard as you do. The highest ROI in the industry.

**Reach new customers**  
Be on the map. Get placement in the official Directory and Floor Plan. Stay visible through 1-on-1 connections.

**Find your next loyal customers**  
Collect qualified customers for your business.

**Ticket deals for you and your team**  
Bring your team with a limited number of Included tickets, and discounts on merch.

### POST EVENT

**Convert leads to real customers**

**Bonus Brand Exposure**  
Feature your company in the post-show wrap email and Highlight Reel, with professional photos of your booth and team in action.

# FAQs

### General

* * *

#### Ticketing Terms and conditions

1. The Weekend Pass ticket holders may enter the venue between the opening hours of the event, as per times advertised.

2. Single Day / Night ticket holders may enter the venue during the opening hours of that day's event only.

3. Concession tickets are available to those with accepted concession cards (full-time students, seniors, veterans, disability cards). You must present your concession card at the entry gate to the event. Valid for one single entry.

4. A carer with a valid carer or companion card receives free entry if accompanying a disabled person (one carer per person). The disabled person requires a concession ticket to enter.

5. Pass-outs are available on any day of the event.

6. Children under 12 are admitted for free when in the company of a paying Adult or Concession ticket holder.

7. All tickets are non-refundable by the Event organiser, except in accordance with the applicable laws in the region of purchase.

8. Unwanted Tickets may be given to another attendee prior to attending the event. 

9. Ticket barcodes are unique to each ticket and may not be shared or duplicated with anyone else or you may be denied entry to the Event. All tickets will be scanned upon entry. The Event organiser reserves the right to deny admission or entry to the holder of any ticket that appears to have been tampered with, counterfeited or duplicated.

10\. All ages are welcome at this event. Ticket holders aged under 18 years must be accompanied by a parent and/or guardian when in the liquor licensed areas. 

11. Event organisers reserve the right to withdraw, reschedule or substitute shows and may vary advertised programs.

12. The event will be operated in accordance with applicable Queensland Health directions in place at the time of the event, which are subject to change. Ticket holders and all visitors to the Event site must comply with these requirements accordingly.

13. No byo alcohol or illicit drugs are to be brought into the Event site.

14. No glass, eskys, umbrellas, video cameras or professional cameras are permitted on the Event site, unless by prior arrangement. Audio or visual recordings of the event are prohibited, but personal phone videos are ok. Still photography is permitted for private purposes. Professional photographers must contact us for media policy and information.

15. Animals are prohibited at the Venue, with the exception of licensed service or assistance animals, such as Guide Dogs.

16. The bar and licensed areas will have amplified music and the Event organiser recommends the use of ear plugs. Free ear plugs are available for ticket holders at the bar.

17. Tickets are to be redeemed at the Event in exchange for a wristband in order to gain entry and re-entry. The wristband must be worn for the duration of the Event.

18. Entry may be refused if tickets are damaged or defaced in any way or are not purchased through an authorised point of sale.

19. The right of admission is reserved and is subject to the event organiser and the venue's terms of admission.

20. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we do not accept liability of any nature for the acts, omissions or default of those providing services in connection with us or any liability for any injury, damage, loss, delay or additional expenses which are incurred at or in association with this event. Where legislation implies any condition or warranty which cannot be excluded or modified, that condition or warranty will be deemed to be included in this agreement. However, our liability for any breach of such condition or warranty will be limited, at our option, to the resupply of the services or the cost of having the services supplied again. In no event will we be liable for any indirect, consequential, exemplary or special damages.

21. You acknowledge that neither we nor the venue will be responsible for any loss or damage to any property (including personal property such as bags, money or other personal items) brought to or purchased at the event by you or your invitees.

22. You will be liable for any loss or damage caused at the event by you or your invitees.

23. Persons entering the event do so at their own risk. The venue and the event organisers and their associates accept no liability for any injury, loss or damage to any person or thing.

24. We reserve the right to cancel or postpone the event for any reason.

25. You must ensure that you and your invitees act in an orderly manner when attending the event. We may refuse entry or evict you or any of your invitees if they are behaving in a disorderly, offensive or anti social manner.

26. The Ticketholder consents to the Event organiser collecting and retaining their personal information for the purposes of the ticket transaction. The Event organiser will hold your information as required by the Privacy Act 1988 and in accordance with the Event’s privacy policy and will contact you in relation to ticketing matters and Event information.

27. There will be no refund on any unused portion of tickets if you or your invitees are asked or forced to leave or if you decide not to attend any part of the Event.

28. We care for the environment and community. Please be respectful and place any litter in the bins provided around the venue. Please respect the neighbourhood when entering and departing the venue and do not cause excessive noise.

* * *

#### Is there a dance floor?

Yes! There is a dance floor in front of the stage at GreazeFest.

* * *

#### Is there seating?

Yes, there are tables and chairs set up in the concert space, as well as theatre style rows of seat, plus room for standing and dancing.

We do not reserve or take bookings for tables for patrons.

Once you are at the venue, it is 'best in, best dressed' for seating.

* * *

#### Will tickets sell out?

Friday night is limited in numbers and may book out.

Saturday and Sunday daytime events are unlimited, but we suggest to get your tickets in advance to receive the discount. 

Saturday and Sunday Show Driver tickets may book out, so please order in advance.

* * *

#### Can my kids come to GreazeFest?

All ages are welcome at GreazeFest.

The licensed area requires all under 18s to be in the direct company of a parent or legal guardian.

IMPORTANT - Parents, please keep your kids under control around the dance floor.

Adults have right of way when dancing. Children are not permitted on the dance floor during event hours unless with a parent or guardian.

* * *

#### Are there any kids activites?

 Yes, there are kids rides at GreazeFest, such as jumping castles. Check our Little Greazers page.

* * *

#### Can I bring my dog?

 No, sorry, no animals permitted, unless a certified assistance dog.

* * *

#### Is there camping / can I sleep in my car?

No. Strictly no camping on the grounds and no one to sleep in the cars in the grounds.

* * *

#### What types of Concession Cards are accepted?

\- Centrelink Pension, Age Pension & Disability Card

\- Seniors Card, all states accepted

\- Veterans Affairs Gold Card

\- DVA Health Card White Card

\- Secondary or Full-time Tertiary Student Card

* * *

### Account Area

* * *

#### What are the benefits of getting an account?

An account is absolutely FREE. With an account you'll be among the first to receive exclusive offers, event promotions / announcements and ticket sales details. You need to have an account to buy tickets, so keep your account details up to date to ensure you don't miss out on any breaking news. [Click here](https://www.greazefest.com/account/new/) to register an account now.

* * *

#### Is the Account Area safe and secure?

Yes, the Account Area is a password protected environment. If you are concerned that you have lost your password, or wish to change your password, you can reset it [here](https://www.greazefest.com/account/forgot_password.aspx) (or navigate to the Account Area login page and click the Forgot Password button).

* * *

#### How do I update my contact details?

Login to the Account Area and click on “My Details” in the Account Area sidebar.

* * *

#### What do I do if I can’t remember what email address I used to register?

Try logging in and see if you can remember what email address you might have used; our system will tell you if the email address you enter does not exist in our system. Otherwise you can [contact us](https://www.greazefest.com/contact/) and we can look up your email address in our system; before doing this we will need to verify your identity.

* * *

#### What do I do if I have forgotten my Password?

Passwords are case sensitive, so check whether you have the Caps-Lock key on and try entering your password again. If this still doesn't work or you think you have forgotten your password, you can reset it [here](https://www.greazefest.com/account/forgot_password.aspx) (or navigate to the Account Area login page and click the Forgot Password button).

* * *

#### Why is an email confirmation required after I have registered an account?

You should receive an email within a few minutes of submitting your online Account registration form. This email includes a link which must be clicked in order to validate your registration. Clicking on this link double-checks that your email address has been correctly recorded and ensures you will receive important news and exclusive offers about the event/s.

When a large number of people are registering at once it may take up to half an hour to receive the confirmation email. If you do not receive a confirmation email, contact us and we'll ensure your registration is completed.

* * *

#### How do I download my E-tickets?

Once e-tickets are available to download from the Account Area the tickets will be stored and remain safe and secure for the life of the ticket, and therefore there is no rush to download. To download these tickets, just login to the Account Area, click on “My Tickets” in the Account Area sidebar. From this page you can choose to Download or Email your E-tickets.

To download your ticket/s you must have Adobe Acrobat Reader installed on your computer. If you do not have it installed, you can download it for free from: [www.adobe.com/products/acrobat/readstep.html](http://www.adobe.com/products/acrobat/readstep.html)

* * *

#### How do I print my E-ticket's in hard copy?

You can print your E-tickets on your home printer in black and white or colour, on standard A4 paper. Please ensure that the barcode has printed correctly, otherwise we might be unable to scan your ticket correctly at the gate. Once printed, please read the terms and conditions.

* * *

#### Why do I need to “name” my E-tickets?

If you have purchased more than one E-ticket, you will need to name the tickets you purchased for the other patrons that will accompany you. This is because in order to gain entry to your event, the name of your ticket must match the name of your ID. To name your tickets, login to the Account Area, click on “My Tickets” in the Account Area sidebar. From this page you can click the “Name” button next to each ticket and enter the name of the person it will belong to. Once you are done you can use the “Download All” to download your individually named tickets as a single PDF ready for printing.

* * *

#### I haven't received my E-Tickets to my email address. What should I do?

If you haven't received your E-Tickets via email within half an hour, please check to see if your mailbox is full or if the email is in your spam folder.

You can also check that your email address is entered correctly in your Account Area, by clicking the My Details button in the Account Area sub-menu. Alternatively, you should [contact us](https://www.greazefest.com/contact/) and we will be able to help you work out why you didn’t receive your tickets and assist in ensuring you receive these as soon as possible.

Note, that you can also download your E-Tickets from your Account Area by going to My Tickets and then click the View Order Details link.

* * *

#### How do I use my E-ticket to gain entry to the event?

On the day of the event simply take your E-ticket/s with you as you would for any event ticket. Please present your E-ticket on arrival at the entry gate. The name on your E-ticket must match the name on your ID.

* * *

#### How do I unsubscribe from the mailing list

Click here to [unsubscribe](https://www.greazefest.com/account/unsubscribe.aspx).

* * *

#### How do I review your Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions?

Click [here](https://www.greazefest.com/privacy/) to read our Privacy Policy.

Click [here](https://www.greazefest.com/terms/) to read our Terms and Conditions.

* * *

#### Need further help?

If you have been unable to find what you need in the Frequently Asked Questions section, and need further help, please complete an online help request by clicking [here](https://www.greazefest.com/contact/).

* * *

### Hot Rod Show

* * *

#### What cars are permitted into the Hot Rod Show?

Preferred vehicles are:

\- American pre-1980  
\- Australian pre-1980  
\- Hot Rod / Rat Rod / Led Sled / Muscle Car / Cool Custom  
\- Vintage motorbike / Bobber  
\- Lowrider cycle 

We are flexible with the entry years, so if you think you'll fit in to the kustom kulture theme, please come along.

* * *

#### Is the Hot Rod Show sanctioned?

There are changes in the ASRF Insurance Policy, meaning events like GreazeFest won't carry a weekend ASRF travel permit. 

What you need to do is - 

all ASRF members driving to GreazeFest need to list their attendance on the ASRF Impromptu Facebook page. 

Please include your rego, car and where you are traveling to and from, on each day that you drive your vehicle. 

[https://www.facebook.com/share/CFaDPvUHF9U7ya4R/](https://www.facebook.com/share/CFaDPvUHF9U7ya4R/)

* * *

#### Can I leave the Hot Rod Show early?

It is recommended that all show vehicles must remain stationary once they have parked in the show.

To accommodate cars that have to leave early, we have designated times, so vehicles can leave 'on the hour' at 2pm, 3pm, 4pm and 5pm. 

Any car moving on the showground site must be ushered by a marshall.

* * *

#### Is there a cost for entering my vehicle?

The discounted Entrant Ticket includes entry for one vehicle and one driver.

Any passengers must hold a Concession, Adult or Teen ticket. 

Please see Tickets page for details.

* * *

### Market Vendors

* * *

#### How do I book a Market Stall at GreazeFest?

1\. Read the Market Terms & Conditions. This is where you can view the dates, times, available sites, site types and pricing.

2\. Complete the Markets Application Form nominating your site/s.

3\. Attach your insurance.

4\. Await your confirmation on email and make your payment by transfer.

Apa itu Soundrenaline 2026?

![Dotted](/assets/soundrenaline/home/dot-pattern.png)

Soundrenaline 2026 resmi hadir sebagai platform festival musik dan ruang kreatif terbaru di Indonesia. Dengan visi menjadi pilar dan katalisator utama dalam industri musik serta ekonomi kreatif nasional, festival ini diperkenalkan sebagai gerakan kolektif yang mendorong kemajuan ekosistem musik, seni, dan industri kreatif Tanah Air.

Apa makna di balik "Sana Sini di (nama kota)"?

![Dotted](/assets/soundrenaline/home/dot-pattern.png)

Soundrenaline 2026 hadir dengan format multi-lokasi dan multi-hari, dirancang untuk melampaui batas skena dan menciptakan ruang inovasi bersama. Festival ini melibatkan puluhan kolektif dan pelaku industri, serta lebih dari 100 musisi dari berbagai kota di Indonesia.

Dimana Soundrenaline dilaksanakan tahun ini?

![Dotted](/assets/soundrenaline/home/dot-pattern.png)

Soundrenaline 2026 akan digelar di lima kota besar Indonesia :

*   Jakarta : 18-19 July 2026
*   Makassar : 29 Agustus 2026
*   Palembang : 19 September 2026
*   Yogyakarta : 31 Oktober 2026
*   Bandung : 21 November 2026

Apa saja konten dan program Soundrenaline tahun ini?

![Dotted](/assets/soundrenaline/home/dot-pattern.png)

Soundrenaline menghadirkan tiga pilar utama :

*   The Stage  
    Panggung musik yang menyajikan beragam genre sesuai preferensipenikmat musik. Selain menampilkan nama-nama besar,Soundrenaline memberi ruang bagi musisi baru dari 37 kota di Indonesia, serta menghadirkan kolaborasi lintas genre dan generasi.
*   The Space  
    Ruang untuk merayakan kreativitas dan seni, serta membangun koneksi dengan para kreator. Temukan koleksi vinyl dan kaset berbagai genre, live auction barang pre-loved, peluncuran album musisi lokal, dan booth kuliner khas dari masing-masing kota.
*   The Lab  
    Inkubator kreatif bagi artis, musisi, dan komunitas untuk mengaktivasi ide-ide mereka. Ikuti diskusi idealisme bermusik bersama “Ale” Saleh Husein (White Shoes & The Couples Company), penampilan 13 Clan Hip Hop, pameran mural, dan sesi jejaring dengan tokoh musik lokal dan internasional dari Primavera, Fuji Rock, dan DMZ Peace Train Festival. 

Apakah Soundrenaline akan hadir tahun depan?

![Dotted](/assets/soundrenaline/home/dot-pattern.png)

Untuk mewujudkan visi jangka panjang, Soundrenaline perlu diselenggarakan secara konsisten. Saat ini, kami sedang menyiapkan konsep untuk Soundrenaline 2026. Informasi lebih lanjut akan kami sampaikan di waktu yang tepat.

Prohibited Items

![Dotted](/assets/soundrenaline/home/dot-pattern.png)

*   No opened pack of cigarettes
*   No selfie stick and camera tripod
*   No professional photography and /or videography, or any type of camera
*   No animals
*   No liquid of any form except liquid vape/pods max of one cartridge
*   No illegal drugs of any kind
*   No outside food, drink, bottle or cans of any type
*   No weapons or any sharp objects
*   No umbrella
*   No backpacks, suitcases, or any large bag
*   No bicycles, skateboards, scooters or vehicle of any kind
*   No fireworks

# Benalla Street Art Festival  
2 - 4 April 2027

## Witness the transformation of a town.

For three unforgettable days, Benalla becomes a living, breathing canvas as world‑class artists bring colour, scale and imagination to the streets of regional Victoria.

**​​2 – 4 April 2027 | Benalla, Victoria**

After the **record‑breaking success of the 2026 festival**, we’re already gearing up to make 2027 **bigger, bolder and more ambitious than ever**.

The Benalla Street Art Festival returns with a renewed vision led by renowned contemporary art curator **Simon Grant**, who will once again bring together an extraordinary lineup of artists to reshape the city in real time.

## This isn't just a gallery walk—it’s an immersive cultural explosion.

With over 95 existing murals and installations already lining our streets, the 2026 festival adds fresh energy, new perspectives, and bold international talent to Australia’s premier regional street art destination.

The festival isn’t just about the art; it’s about the community vibe. It’s the perfect chance to see the art in everything, uncover hidden gems, and dive deep into the creative culture of regional Victoria.

From live mural paintings, to artist workshops and guided walking tours, this is the perfect event for everyone from die-hard art lovers to those seeking a unique weekend away.

## Welcome to The Big Sweat

### What is The Big Sweat?

Hosted by [Blue Mountains Sauna](https://bmsauna.com.au/) in Leura and supported by the [Australian Sauna Association](https://saunaaustralia.org.au/), The Big Sweat is a weekend dedicated to reconnecting with the things modern life too often pulls us away from: ourselves, each other, and the simple things that make us feel human. Through the shared ritual of sauna, we aim to bring people together for a weekend of presence, community, nature, learning, movement and joy, while celebrating the culture that is growing around sauna across Australia.

The weekend will feature five saunas, each offering a unique experience. From traditional Finnish sauna and guided Aufguss ceremonies to quieter, more meditative sessions, there will be something for every kind of sauna-goer. Beyond the heat, enjoy live music, Pilates, yoga, breathwork, talks, workshops, games and delicious food throughout the weekend.

### Who is it for?

The Big Sweat is for everyone, whether you're coming solo or with a group. Sauna is one of the easiest places to arrive solo and leave feeling connected.

### What does it celebrate?

Australia's sauna culture is still young, but it's growing quickly. The Big Sweat is where that emerging culture gathers in one place to celebrate how far we've come, connect with one another, and help shape what comes next.

  

The weekend also celebrates four years of [Blue Mountains Sauna](https://bmsauna.com.au/) championing authentic sauna culture in Australia, along with the launch of their Savu sauna (smoke sauna), the first of its kind in the Southern Hemisphere.

A weekend to slow down, reconnect, and feel more human through the shared ritual of sauna.

## Whats happening

Your festival pass includes a two-hour sauna session. Outside your session, you're encouraged to arrive early or stay afterwards to enjoy everything else the festival has to offer.

## The details

Who it's for

Everyone. Whether you're new to sauna or sauna-crazy.

Adult & kids tickets available.

Hours

Saturday & Sunday.

What to bring

*   Two towels: one to sit on, one to dry off
*   Water bottle
*   Robe or warm layer
*   Slides or waterproof footwear
*   Good vibes

[Read the wrap-up](https://saunaaustralia.org.au/news/thats-a-wrap-on-the-big-sweat-2026)

## Make a weekend out of it

If you're travelling to Leura for The Big Sweat, Comfort Resort Leura Gardens has kindly offered discounted stays for festival guests across the weekend.

Stay nearby, take your time and turn the gathering into a proper Blue Mountains escape.

![Comfort Resort Leura Gardens logo](/media/saunas/the-big-sweat-landing-57f3c200.webp)

Honouring the ritual

## The art of Aufguss.

As sauna grows in Australia, so does the responsibility to honour the traditions behind it. Aufguss, pronounced _owf-gooss_, is one of the most celebrated of these. A trained sauna master pours water infused with essential oils over the stones, then uses carefully choreographed towel work to circulate the steam through the room. It is immersive, physical and deeply grounding.

At The Big Sweat we bring Aufguss to life across the weekend through dedicated Aufguss saunas, run by experienced facilitators, alongside hands-on towel work workshops so you can feel the craft yourself rather than only watch it. It is part of how the ASA is helping Aufguss take root here with authenticity and respect, building toward a national championship and a pathway for Australian competitors on the world stage.

Aufguss training coming soon

![An Aufguss ceremony in progress](/media/saunas/the-big-sweat-landing-a1e0fd13.webp)

## Frequently asked

How do I get there?

The easiest option is the train from Central to Leura Station, then it's just a few minutes' walk to The Big Sweat. If you're driving, please carpool where possible and park at Leura Mall or near Woolworths. Please don't park on Quinns Avenue or at Blue Mountains Sauna.

Do I need any sauna experience?

None at all. The weekend is designed to welcome complete first-timers alongside seasoned bathers. Come as you are and go at your own pace.

What should I bring?

Sessions are clothed, so bring swimwear. Pack two towels, a robe or warm layer, a waterbottle, and waterproof footwear such as slides.

Is there parking?

Parking is available at Leura Mall or nearby Woolworths, not on Quinns Avenue or at Blue Mountains Sauna.

Can I bring children?

Yes. Child tickets are available and family-friendly bathing times and activities are part of the program.

What is Aufguss?

Aufguss is a guided steam ritual where a sauna master pours infused water over the stones and circulates the steam with choreographed towel work. You can experience it across the weekend in our dedicated Aufguss saunas.

Where does the donation go?

Three percent of net proceeds goes to Sauna Aid, which brings the warmth and comfort of sauna to communities in need.

## Get involved

There is more than one way to be part of The Big Sweat. If any of these sound like you, we would love to hear from you.

### Run a market stall

Makers, sauna-adjacent brands and local businesses are invited to express interest in a stall at the festival.

### Host a session

Pitch a workshop, movement class, talk or something in between as part of the weekend program.

### Volunteer

Keen to help make the weekend happen? Put your hand up to volunteer with the team.

### Sponsors & Press

### Sponsor the event

Brands and partners interested in supporting The Big Sweat are warmly invited to get in touch. Come and be part of Australia's first national sauna gathering, with a captive audience of sauna & wellness enthusiasts.

### Media & press

Journalists and outlets are welcome to reach out for interviews, images and press access across the weekend.

[Get in touch](mailto:joinus@saunaaustralia.org.au)

Join the fun.

The national peak body for sauna in Australia. We grow and support authentic, accessible, and culturally informed sauna culture across the country.

A not-for-profit, and a proud member of the [International Sauna Association](https://saunainternational.net/members/). We're listed as the national member body for Australia.

We donate a minimum of 3% of gross revenue to [Sauna Aid](https://sauna-aid.com/), getting the healing power of heat to communities that need it most.

# About the Festival

THE REALM OF ART COVERS AN extensive array of subjects. Benalla Street Art Festival unveils an eclectic line-up that highlights renowned and diverse artists.

Our aspiration is for the Benalla Street Art Festival to evolve into a nationally renowned celebration of arts and culture, showcasing diversity, inclusivity, and accessibility.  
  
The result is a celebration of artistic diversity that transcends borders and brings together creatives from various corners of the globe and the local landscape.

## **Benalla Street Art Festival History**

Every April, the streets of Benalla burst into colour as artists from across Australia and around the world transform the town into a giant open-air gallery.

**Benalla Street Art Festival** began in 2015 with a bold idea: invite world-class street artists to paint monumental murals across the regional Victorian town of Benalla. What started as a community-driven experiment quickly captured international attention, putting Benalla firmly on the global street art map.

Today the festival draws thousands of visitors who come to watch the creative magic unfold live. Over three vibrant days, towering murals appear on walls across town as artists work high on scaffolds and cherry pickers, turning blank spaces into extraordinary works of art.

Beyond the murals, the festival buzzes with guided art walks, exhibitions, cinema. talks, workshops and live music, giving visitors plenty of reasons to wander, explore and soak up the atmosphere.

With more than 80 murals already scattered across town, Benalla has become one of Australia’s most exciting regional street art destinations.

Come for the festival. Stay to discover a town where every street corner tells a colourful story and you can….See the art in everything.

Our story

# Guiding the growth of the Australian sauna industry.

New saunas are opening across the country. We're here to build the standards, education, and connections the industry needs.

Sauna is growing quickly in Australia, part of a broader shift toward recovery, preventative health, and social connection. New operators are opening across the country: bathhouses, beachside trailers, community wellness spaces, even floating sauna boats. Public interest keeps rising, from media coverage to Google search trends.

But growth like this brings its own challenges. Operators face unclear permitting pathways, inconsistent regulations, limited public education, and no real industry standards or representation. It became clear that Australia needed a national body to help guide this growth.

There was a cultural gap too. Much of what has been called sauna in Australia over the decades had been stripped of the culture that produced it: dry rooms where water never touches the stones, a communal practice reduced to a solitary wellness product. Sauna's home is Finland, where UNESCO recognises sauna culture as Intangible Cultural Heritage, and its relatives stretch from Estonia's smoke saunas to the Aufguss halls of Central Europe. We exist to grow an Australian sauna culture that carries that context with it, not one that trades on the word while leaving its meaning behind.

The Australian Sauna Association is the national body for sauna in Australia. We continue the work started by the Australian Sweat Bathing Association (ASBA), which began as a grassroots effort to support Australia's growing sauna community. That work has grown into an organisation supporting the country's sauna network: operators, builders, suppliers, researchers, and sauna lovers.

Through events, education, advocacy, and collaboration, we're helping sauna culture in Australia grow sustainably. We're also leading the growth of Aufguss in Australia, the ritual art of pouring water and scent over hot stones, and building the national pathway to the Aufguss World Championships.

![A wood-fired mobile sauna at sunset on an Australian beach](/_astro/our-story-growth.Fy9_nBV4_cxh5j.webp)

A woodfired sauna on the coast at sunset, part of Australia's fast-growing sauna scene.

## Our work is putting the context back in.

And from there, growing something honestly ours: sauna informed by the traditions that built it, and alive to a landscape they never imagined. Heat in the eucalypt air, steam off a river at dusk, a cold plunge under southern stars. Learned deeply, practised creatively, at home here.

What we're building

## The infrastructure a national industry needs.

Membership connects operators, builders, and bathers to the tools growing sauna across Australia.

### National Sauna Map

Find the heat near you, from wood-fired barrels to public bathhouses, and put your own sauna on the map.

### Expert Network

Find vetted builders, operators and practitioners, or be found. Searchable, contactable and verified.

### Jobs Network

Roles across Australian sauna, from building and operations to front of house. Browse, post and get hired.

### Marketplace

Buy and sell within the community: stoves, benches, barrels and the gear that makes a sauna.

### Offers

Discounts, services and opportunities from Sauna Professionals across Australia, shared just for members.

### Events

ASA gatherings and member-run events, from webinars and workshops to bathing sessions and the annual get-together. Publish your own, too.

### Resource Library

Sauna blueprints, wellness guides and the Operators' Charter, the practical know-how to build and run well.

### Community Forums

Discussion boards to ask, share and connect with the people building the same thing.

### Member messaging

Reach experts, operators and other members directly. Every conversation is one message away.

[See membership](https://saunaaustralia.org.au/get-involved#membership)

Connected

## Part of a global movement.

![International Sauna Association](/assets/images/logos/isa-logo.png)

### Recognised by the ISA

The ASA is the recognised national member body for Australia of the International Sauna Association, connecting us to a global community of sauna experts, practitioners, and researchers. Their goal is to publicise sauna and promote its use on a global scale by rallying supporters of sauna activities across the world. The ASA brings that movement to Australia.

[Visit the ISA](https://saunainternational.net/)

![Sauna Aid](/assets/images/logos/sauna-aid-logo.png)

### We back Sauna Aid

Sauna Aid is a global initiative bringing sauna relief to communities in crisis, using portable heat and steam to support recovery, wellbeing, and connection where it's needed most. As a not-for-profit, the ASA donates a minimum of 3% of gross revenue to Sauna Aid, supporting their vital work.

[Visit Sauna Aid](https://sauna-aid.com/)

### Close to the source

We work in ongoing relationship with the cultures sauna comes from: Finnish practitioners and researchers, and the wider international sauna community. Our team has also had the privilege of running the Finnish Embassy's Windows to the World sauna in Canberra. That closeness keeps our standards, education, and events grounded in the traditions they draw on.

[Explore the traditions](https://saunaaustralia.org.au/what-is-a-sauna)

## Be part of the story.

Join the movement, or put your sauna on the national map.

[Become a member](https://saunaaustralia.org.au/get-involved#membership) [Meet the team](https://saunaaustralia.org.au/meet-the-team)

![Australian Sauna Association](/assets/images/logos/asa-logo-white.png)

The national peak body for sauna in Australia. We grow and support authentic, accessible, and culturally informed sauna culture across the country.

A not-for-profit, and a proud member of the [International Sauna Association](https://saunainternational.net/members/). We're listed as the national member body for Australia.

We donate a minimum of 3% of gross revenue to [Sauna Aid](https://sauna-aid.com/), getting the healing power of heat to communities that need it most.

## ULUWATU SINGLE FIN CLASSIC 17-18 August 2024

As one of Bali’s most prestigious events, this year’s Uluwatu Single Fin Classic promises to be the best yet. World champions Mark Occhilupo, Joel Parkinson, Mikey February, Joel Tudor, and Tosh Tudor, along with iconic Indonesian surfers, will join the lineup.  
  
The Single Fin Classic celebrates the history and iconic visuals that put Uluwatu on the surfing map in 1972. All boards must be original pre-1990s designs, reflecting the era when single fin surfboards were the only choice.  
  
SFC kicks off on Friday, August 16, with a panel talk featuring Occy, Parko, Mike February, Joel, and Tosh Tudor. Daily live music will play from noon until late. With a favorable long-range forecast, this year’s Uluwatu Single Fin Classic promises an exciting weekend for all Bali lovers.

# Join the sauna movement.

Whether you're just curious or already deep in the löyly, the best place to start is a membership. Together we raise standards, share knowledge, and grow sauna culture across Australia.

Membership

## Three ways to back the movement.

Every membership backs the work that grows and protects Australian sauna culture. Find the one that fits, or start with the [mailing list](https://saunaaustralia.org.au/get-involved#mailing-list) and stay close until you're ready.

### Sauna Enthusiast

$55 / year

[Become an Enthusiast](https://saunaaustralia.org.au/get-involved#mailing-list)

Become part of Australia's growing sauna community.

*   **Updates** Regular newsletters and announcements, first word on what's coming.
*   **Events** Member access and discounts to events, workshops and webinars.
*   **Jobs** Browse and apply for roles on the national Jobs Network.
*   **Sauna Map** Add a new listing or claim an existing one. Every submission is reviewed and approved by the ASA.
*   **Community** Join the community boards: ask questions, post, reply and vote across Australia.
*   **Offers** Discounts on saunas and sauna-related products and services.
*   **Support** Help grow authentic sauna culture across Australia.

Most popular

### Sauna Advocate

$99 / year

[Become an Advocate](https://saunaaustralia.org.au/get-involved#mailing-list)

For the seriously keen who want a real hand in shaping the community.

*   **Everything in Enthusiast** Included.
*   **Resources** Access guides, templates and research written by industry experts.
*   **Direct messaging** Message other members one to one through the member portal.
*   **Expert Network** List yourself, flag yourself available for hire, and contact other vetted industry experts (builders, operators and practitioners).

### Sauna Professional

From $249 / year

Pricing based on bookable seats. Application only, subject to passing standards.

Apply to join

For business members in the sauna and broader wellness industry.

*   **Everything in Advocate** Included.
*   **Expert Network** Verified Professional listing for extra visibility and credibility.
*   **Hiring** Post job vacancies on the Jobs Network and manage applicants.
*   **Events** Publish and promote your own community events for all members to see and sign up to.
*   **Sauna Highlights** Submit your sauna for our Member Sauna Highlights series and be featured across the ASA's channels.
*   **Recognition** ASA Approved Operator certification with logo use, once approved.Coming soon
*   **Team access** Free ASA memberships for your staff under your account. Max seats apply depending on team size, reviewed upon application.

## Every dollar goes back into the movement.

We're a not-for-profit. Membership funds the work that grows and protects sauna culture in Australia, and we report it back to members at our AGM.

### The infrastructure

The national sauna map, the jobs and expert networks, the resource library, and the forums you use.

### Advocacy & access

Our work with councils, insurers, and building codes to make sauna easier to build, run, and reach.

### Events & research

Webinars, gatherings like The Big Sweat, and funding research into sauna's health benefits.

**And we give back.** We donate a minimum of 3% of gross revenue to Sauna Aid, getting sauna relief to communities in crisis. It's a floor, not a ceiling, and we report it. [Read our governance and transparency →](https://saunaaustralia.org.au/governance)

![Australian Sauna Association](/assets/images/logos/asa-logo-white.png)

The national peak body for sauna in Australia. We grow and support authentic, accessible, and culturally informed sauna culture across the country.

A not-for-profit, and a proud member of the [International Sauna Association](https://saunainternational.net/members/). We're listed as the national member body for Australia.

# FAQs

### General

* * *

#### Ticketing Terms and conditions

1. The Weekend Pass ticket holders may enter the venue between the opening hours of the event, as per times advertised.

2. Single Day / Night ticket holders may enter the venue during the opening hours of that day's event only.

3. Concession tickets are available to those with accepted concession cards (full-time students, seniors, veterans, disability cards). You must present your concession card at the entry gate to the event. Valid for one single entry.

4. A carer with a valid carer or companion card receives free entry if accompanying a disabled person (one carer per person). The disabled person requires a concession ticket to enter.

5. Pass-outs are available on any day of the event.

6. Children under 12 are admitted for free when in the company of a paying Adult or Concession ticket holder.

7. All tickets are non-refundable by the Event organiser, except in accordance with the applicable laws in the region of purchase.

8. Unwanted Tickets may be given to another attendee prior to attending the event. 

9. Ticket barcodes are unique to each ticket and may not be shared or duplicated with anyone else or you may be denied entry to the Event. All tickets will be scanned upon entry. The Event organiser reserves the right to deny admission or entry to the holder of any ticket that appears to have been tampered with, counterfeited or duplicated.

10\. All ages are welcome at this event. Ticket holders aged under 18 years must be accompanied by a parent and/or guardian when in the liquor licensed areas. 

11. Event organisers reserve the right to withdraw, reschedule or substitute shows and may vary advertised programs.

12. The event will be operated in accordance with applicable Queensland Health directions in place at the time of the event, which are subject to change. Ticket holders and all visitors to the Event site must comply with these requirements accordingly.

13. No byo alcohol or illicit drugs are to be brought into the Event site.

14. No glass, eskys, umbrellas, video cameras or professional cameras are permitted on the Event site, unless by prior arrangement. Audio or visual recordings of the event are prohibited, but personal phone videos are ok. Still photography is permitted for private purposes. Professional photographers must contact us for media policy and information.

15. Animals are prohibited at the Venue, with the exception of licensed service or assistance animals, such as Guide Dogs.

16. The bar and licensed areas will have amplified music and the Event organiser recommends the use of ear plugs. Free ear plugs are available for ticket holders at the bar.

17. Tickets are to be redeemed at the Event in exchange for a wristband in order to gain entry and re-entry. The wristband must be worn for the duration of the Event.

18. Entry may be refused if tickets are damaged or defaced in any way or are not purchased through an authorised point of sale.

19. The right of admission is reserved and is subject to the event organiser and the venue's terms of admission.

20. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we do not accept liability of any nature for the acts, omissions or default of those providing services in connection with us or any liability for any injury, damage, loss, delay or additional expenses which are incurred at or in association with this event. Where legislation implies any condition or warranty which cannot be excluded or modified, that condition or warranty will be deemed to be included in this agreement. However, our liability for any breach of such condition or warranty will be limited, at our option, to the resupply of the services or the cost of having the services supplied again. In no event will we be liable for any indirect, consequential, exemplary or special damages.

21. You acknowledge that neither we nor the venue will be responsible for any loss or damage to any property (including personal property such as bags, money or other personal items) brought to or purchased at the event by you or your invitees.

22. You will be liable for any loss or damage caused at the event by you or your invitees.

23. Persons entering the event do so at their own risk. The venue and the event organisers and their associates accept no liability for any injury, loss or damage to any person or thing.

24. We reserve the right to cancel or postpone the event for any reason.

25. You must ensure that you and your invitees act in an orderly manner when attending the event. We may refuse entry or evict you or any of your invitees if they are behaving in a disorderly, offensive or anti social manner.

26. The Ticketholder consents to the Event organiser collecting and retaining their personal information for the purposes of the ticket transaction. The Event organiser will hold your information as required by the Privacy Act 1988 and in accordance with the Event’s privacy policy and will contact you in relation to ticketing matters and Event information.

27. There will be no refund on any unused portion of tickets if you or your invitees are asked or forced to leave or if you decide not to attend any part of the Event.

28. We care for the environment and community. Please be respectful and place any litter in the bins provided around the venue. Please respect the neighbourhood when entering and departing the venue and do not cause excessive noise.

* * *

#### Is there a dance floor?

Yes! There is a dance floor in front of the stage at GreazeFest.

* * *

#### Is there seating?

Yes, there are tables and chairs set up in the concert space, as well as theatre style rows of seat, plus room for standing and dancing.

We do not reserve or take bookings for tables for patrons.

Once you are at the venue, it is 'best in, best dressed' for seating.

* * *

#### Will tickets sell out?

Friday night is limited in numbers and may book out.

Saturday and Sunday daytime events are unlimited, but we suggest to get your tickets in advance to receive the discount. 

Saturday and Sunday Show Driver tickets may book out, so please order in advance.

* * *

#### Can my kids come to GreazeFest?

All ages are welcome at GreazeFest.

The licensed area requires all under 18s to be in the direct company of a parent or legal guardian.

IMPORTANT - Parents, please keep your kids under control around the dance floor.

Adults have right of way when dancing. Children are not permitted on the dance floor during event hours unless with a parent or guardian.

* * *

#### Are there any kids activites?

 Yes, there are kids rides at GreazeFest, such as jumping castles. Check our Little Greazers page.

* * *

#### Can I bring my dog?

 No, sorry, no animals permitted, unless a certified assistance dog.

* * *

#### Is there camping / can I sleep in my car?

No. Strictly no camping on the grounds and no one to sleep in the cars in the grounds.

* * *

#### What types of Concession Cards are accepted?

\- Centrelink Pension, Age Pension & Disability Card

\- Seniors Card, all states accepted

\- Veterans Affairs Gold Card

\- DVA Health Card White Card

\- Secondary or Full-time Tertiary Student Card

* * *

Committee & Ambassadors

# Meet the people behind the ASA.

A volunteer Committee leads the Association, backed by a wider bench of Ambassadors. Together they're founders, operators, builders, architects, and advocates, united by a love of authentic sauna and a commitment to growing it well.

Committee Representatives

## The people leading the Association.

Our governing volunteer body: founders, operators, builders, and advocates who steer the ASA and its work.

![Portrait of Nikita Miltiadou](/media/committee/nikita-miltiadou-bdffeffd.webp)

### Nikita Miltiadou

President

Founding President of the Australian Sauna Association and co-founder of Blue Mountains Sauna in Leura, one of the first venues in the country dedicated to an authentic Finnish-style sauna experience. A leading voice in Australia's sauna movement, he's focused on raising standards, building community, and reintroducing traditional sauna culture in a uniquely local context.

Read more

![Portrait of Paul Strasser](/media/committee/paul-strasser-b0a1a351.webp)

### Paul Strasser

Vice President

Vice-President of the ASA, Paul fell in love with sauna while living in the UK. With his background in strategy & operations, Paul helps sauna & wellness businesses across Australia, New Zealand, & Canada unlock revenue through partnerships & pricing strategies, scale operations, & better plan finances. He's also an experienced sauna host, facilitating guided meditations, breathwork, and aufguss rituals.

Read more

![Portrait of Freddie Grimwade](/media/committee/freddie-grimwade-42ace700.webp)

### Freddie Grimwade

Treasurer

Treasurer of the ASA, Freddie brings a background in corporate finance, investment, and financial modelling. His love of sauna began while living in the UK, and he now brings his wealth of knowledge in finance & social enterprises to the ASA, supporting our growth journey and mission as a not-for-profit.

Read more

![Portrait of Naomi Gregory](/media/committee/naomi-gregory-0b46f4fb.webp)

### Naomi Gregory

Representative

A veteran of the Australian spa and wellness industry, Naomi has spent more than 30 years shaping wellness destinations in Australia and abroad. After training with leading Aufguss Masters in Europe, she is now helping grow authentic sauna culture in Australia as the Australian Sauna Association’s Committee Member lead for Aufguss & Sauna Rituals, supporting training, events and the national pathway toward the World Championships.

Read more

![Portrait of Chloe Gore](/media/committee/chloe-gore-9e0f78e0.webp)

### Chloe Gore

Representative

Co-founder of Kuuma Nature Sauna, Australia's first sauna boat, offering sauna cruises she runs alongside her husband Nathan. With a background in event management, design, and architecture, she's passionate about bringing people together through heat, connection, and the revival of the icy plunge.

Read more

![Portrait of Rob Dempster-Smith](/media/committee/m8-79f433d5.webp)

### Rob Dempster-Smith

Representative

Founder of Cedar & Salt, a mobile woodfired sauna business bringing traditional heat to wild, natural settings across NSW. Inspired by Nordic sweat bathing during his time in Amsterdam, Rob now helps others navigate the trailer sauna space through hands-on experience, advocacy, and community connection.

Read more

![Portrait of Adam Strupek](/media/committee/adam-strupek-226bd822.webp)

### Adam Strupek

Representative

Founder of Aesir Mentoring, Adam blends Nordic esoteric teachings with sauna, breathwork, and cold exposure to guide inner transformation. Raised in Brisbane with Czech roots, he's used the sauna since age 12. His Nordic Ceremonial Sauna weaves löyly, Sami-inspired ritual, and storytelling to foster clarity, resilience, and deep self-connection.

Read more

![Portrait of Drew Neiht](/media/committee/drew-neiht-53bf6315.webp)

### Drew Neiht

Representative

Founder of Wilderness Saunas, crafting authentic, sustainable sauna experiences across Australia. With roots in construction, wellness, and European sauna culture, he blends hands-on expertise with cultural insight. Drew also advocates for public bathing and eco-building through consulting, design, and community-driven projects.

Read more

![Portrait of Harry Borthwick](/media/committee/m13-1a0fa681.jpg)

### Harry Borthwick

Representative

Committee Representative and co-founder of HÅUT HUTT, Harry is helping bring wood-fired sauna to Victoria’s High Country. He brings a regional perspective to the ASA, with a focus on outdoor sauna, authentic heat, and nature-based community bathing.

Read more

![Portrait of Jack Tsonis](/media/committee/jack-tsonis-8d01a115.webp)

### Jack Tsonis

Representative

Longtime advocate for authentic public bathing culture. As the co-founder of the Australian Sweat Bathing Alliance (ASBA), Jack has helped lay the groundwork for a national movement reconnecting people with the health, social, and spiritual benefits of heat. With a background in philosophy and cultural theory, he brings a unique depth to the sauna conversation, linking ancient traditions with contemporary wellbeing and climate-conscious living.

Read more

Ambassadors

## A wider bench for the movement.

Active members who champion authentic sauna and represent the ASA around the country.

![Portrait of Amy Salisbury](/media/committee/amy-salisbury-8cf20011.webp)

### Amy Salisbury

Ambassador

Owner of Seasoul Sauna, a seaside barrel sauna in Melbourne dedicated to an authentic, community-minded sauna experience. Drawing on ancient Nordic practice, Seasoul pairs sauna bathing and cold plunge with the restorative pull of nature, a place to connect, heal, and thrive.

Read more

![Portrait of Ben Miqueu](/media/committee/ben-miqueu-831e96d1.webp)

### Ben Miqueu

Ambassador

Ben has spent over a decade advising start-ups, entrepreneurs, and SMEs across Africa, Asia, and the Pacific. He brings a background in governance, senior management, business development, and international consulting to the ASA, helping us build strong foundations as we grow, while connecting Australia's growing sauna community with the wider world, alongside a genuine love of authentic sauna.

Read more

![Portrait of James Mugavin](/media/committee/james-maguvin-bbe9ae9a.webp)

### James Mugavin

Ambassador

Founder of J.A. Mugavin Studio, an architecture and design practice focused on wellness spaces and community connection. With a passion for sauna culture and slow, human-centred design, James bridges architectural excellence with traditional bathing values. He works across public and private projects to help shape a uniquely Australian sauna landscape.

Read more

## Want to help shape the movement?

Membership is open to bathers, builders, operators, and everyone in between.

[Get involved](https://saunaaustralia.org.au/get-involved#membership)

![Australian Sauna Association](/assets/images/logos/asa-logo-white.png)

The national peak body for sauna in Australia. We grow and support authentic, accessible, and culturally informed sauna culture across the country.

A not-for-profit, and a proud member of the [International Sauna Association](https://saunainternational.net/members/). We're listed as the national member body for Australia.

We donate a minimum of 3% of gross revenue to [Sauna Aid](https://sauna-aid.com/), getting the healing power of heat to communities that need it most.

title: DESIGNART | TOP
description:
DESIGNART（デザイナート）とは、デザインとアートを横断する、感動を与えてくれるモノやコトを新たに定義した言葉で、その素晴らしさを発信、共有していくための活動そのものの名前です。“Emotional Life〜感動のある暮らし〜”をコンセプトに、世界中の感動をもたらしてくれるデザイン＆アートなモノ・コトを提供していきます。 

近年、デザインとアートが密接に絡み合い、横断するモノが世界的なムーブメントとなるなか、世界の良質な伝統産業やものづくりの現場が生き残っていくうえでも、それら固有のアイデンティティをデザインやアート、アイデアで明確にし、世界中の“感動のある暮らし”を求めている人へ伝える力が必要だと、私たちは考えています。デザインやアートと同じレベルで使う一般用語として「DESIGNART」という言葉を浸透させること、そして生活をより豊かに彩ることを目指し、私たちはDESIGNARTを日本、そして世界に広めるためのサステイナブルな活動を行っていきます。

## Design

POWER TO THE CREATIVES

## & Art

## デザイン、アートが織りなす感動の入口

DESIGNART（デザイナート）とは、デザインとアートを横断する、感動を与えてくれるモノやコトを新たに定義した言葉で、その素晴らしさを発信、共有していくための活動そのものの名前です。“Emotions〜感動の入口〜”をコンセプトに、世界中の感動をもたらしてくれるデザイン＆アートなモノ・コトを提供していきます。  
  
近年、デザインとアートが密接に絡み合い、横断するモノが世界的なムーブメントとなるなか、世界の良質な伝統産業やものづくりの現場が生き残っていくうえでも、それら固有のアイデンティティをデザインやアート、アイデアで明確にし、世界中の"Emotions"を求めている人へ伝える力が必要だと、私たちは考えています。デザインやアートと同じレベルで使う一般用語として「DESIGNART」という言葉を浸透させること、そして生活をより豊かに彩ることを目指し、私たちはDESIGNARTを日本、そして世界に広めるためのサステイナブルな活動を行っていきます。

About

## About

## コンセプト

![](https://www.designart.jp/wp-content/themes/designart/statics/images/about/circle.png)

「DESIGNART」（デザイナート）は、さまざまなジャンルの垣根を超えて、デザインとアートを横断するモノやコトの素晴らしさを発信、共有してゆく活動です。  
“東京の街全体がミュージアムになる12日間”  
私たちDESIGNARTは、その活動の発表の場として、毎年秋に開催するデザイン& アートフェスティバル「DESIGNART TOKYO」を企画・運営しています。  
世界屈指のミックスカルチャー都市・東京を舞台に、世界中からアート、建築、インテリア、プロダクト、ファッション、フード、スポーツ、テクノロジーなどのモノとコトが集結し、ギャラリーやショップなど、さまざまな場所を利用して多彩なプレゼンテーションを行う革新的な取り組みです。各展示を回遊して街歩きを楽しめる、まさに東京の街全体がデザイン& アートミュージアムになるイベントです。

## ヴィジョン

1\. 日本を中心としたクリエイティブ産業の活性化

より多くの人が質の高いものづくりに触れ合い、「価値のある暮らし」という体験の積み重ねをすることがクリエイティブ業界の活性化につながると考えます。企画・運営するフェスティバルでは、この時限りの一品を購入できる場となります。購入希望者への支援策としての「インテリアローン・ ショッピングクレジット」の普及活動なども行なっております。

2\. 世界の人々が創造的に感化しあうプラットフォームの提供

ジャンルを問わない国内外の様々なクリエイティブ関係者が交わることで、想像を超えた化学反応が生まれ、新しいプロジェクトへの発展、思いもよらない出会いをボーダレスに繋ぐ環境や機会を提供します。

3\. 若手デザイナー/アーティストの後押し

10年後・20年後の文化発展を見据え、 若手クリエイターが冒険心をもち、独創性のある作品を発表する機会を構築していきます。

## 事業内容

*   デザインからアートまで独創性の高いプロモーション事業
*   世界のクリエイターが手がけるパブリックアート事業
*   地域と連携した観光文化イベントのコンサルティング事業

### Hot Rod Show

* * *

#### What cars are permitted into the Hot Rod Show?

Preferred vehicles are:

\- American pre-1980  
\- Australian pre-1980  
\- Hot Rod / Rat Rod / Led Sled / Muscle Car / Cool Custom  
\- Vintage motorbike / Bobber  
\- Lowrider cycle 

We are flexible with the entry years, so if you think you'll fit in to the kustom kulture theme, please come along.

* * *

#### Is the Hot Rod Show sanctioned?

There are changes in the ASRF Insurance Policy, meaning events like GreazeFest won't carry a weekend ASRF travel permit. 

What you need to do is - 

all ASRF members driving to GreazeFest need to list their attendance on the ASRF Impromptu Facebook page. 

Please include your rego, car and where you are traveling to and from, on each day that you drive your vehicle. 

[https://www.facebook.com/share/CFaDPvUHF9U7ya4R/](https://www.facebook.com/share/CFaDPvUHF9U7ya4R/)

* * *

#### Can I leave the Hot Rod Show early?

It is recommended that all show vehicles must remain stationary once they have parked in the show.

To accommodate cars that have to leave early, we have designated times, so vehicles can leave 'on the hour' at 2pm, 3pm, 4pm and 5pm. 

Any car moving on the showground site must be ushered by a marshall.

* * *

#### Is there a cost for entering my vehicle?

The discounted Entrant Ticket includes entry for one vehicle and one driver.

Any passengers must hold a Concession, Adult or Teen ticket. 

Please see Tickets page for details.

You're welcome to leave your footprints on our land.

Pay tribute to the traditional custodians of country, and follow in the footsteps of Gundungurra ancestors who traversed these lands for thousands of years. From the traditional Welcome to Country on the start line to the sounds of the yidaki out on Ironpot ridge, we encourage you to immerse yourself in the full indigenous experience of being on and experiencing country.

Take your breath away

Located in the world heritage listed Blue Mountains, the stairs won’t be the only thing taking your breath away at UTA. From the vast cliff tops and exposed rock formations to the cascading waterfalls and chorusing native bush alive with the sounds of nature – there’s something to take in at every point along the UTA course.

Welcome to the family

Every runner that steps on our start lines is a new member of the UTA family. Become part of the welcoming and inclusive trail running community, where you can chat with fellow trail frothers at our trail running expo, make new trail friends in town, and get to know strangers on the trails – we’re not joking when we say life long friends are made on the trails of UTA!

### Basa Bali

The mission of BASAbali is to bring together experts on Balinese language and culture to create the first multimedia language materials for spoken Balinese and the endangered Balinese script and to more generally promote the use and understanding of Balinese. BASAbali will donate all of its materials to nonprofit organizations free of charge.

A the 2015 BaliSpirit Festival, BASAbali will be the hosts for Balinese programs for adults and kids. Read about them more on the [Hari Cinta Keluarga](https://balispiritfestival.com/program/hari-cinta-keluarga-family-day)

**Read more about BASAbali in this recent press release:**

Technology Gives New Spark to Minority Language  
BASAbali organizes project to create learning materials for threatened Balinese language  
Feb. 2013 – BASAbali, a nonprofit organization created to provide a vehicle to electronically bring together anthropologists, linguists, and videographers from around the world, announced today the release of the first multimedia materials for the teaching of Balinese. The Austronesian language is the native tongue of a diminishing 1 million out of 3 million people living in Bali and its script is already endangered. As with other minority languages, globalization and tourism encourages the use of English, while the central government’s effort to keep together a country of disparate ethnic groups promotes the use of the national Indonesian.

“Bringing together expertise to create modern, engaging materials to learn Balinese is tremendous progress for the Balinese language to be recognized as part of the universe of languages and for Bali to be well known not just as paradise island but also one that is rich which indigenous culture. The materials will help Balinese thrive even in the middle of globalization,” explains Ayu Mandala, Program Manager of BASAbali.

Money for the project was raised on Kickstarter.com, an online fundraising tool, which also produced donations of legal expertise, a sound studio, logo design, and publicity. “Desktop volunteers” found through Sparked.com came forward to design the website and produce e-learning modules. Balinese videographers were located on YouTube, while linguistic and cultural listservers connected BASAbali with linguists and anthropologists. Transparent Language, a leading provider of language-learning technology, donated its software and hundreds of hours of technical expertise.

The resulting materials consist of 24 dialogue-based videos, language exercises, and grammatical notes that focus on modern, conversational Balinese. Many of the videos focus on contemporary issues facing Bali, such as organic gardening, recycling; smoking restrictions, etc. so that the videos come to life in contemporary culture. Interactive modules teach the language’s endangered script. Drawing from the extensive body of literature on Bali, the materials will also serve as a gateway to resources on Balinese culture more generally. The materials will be distributed, free of charge, to nonprofit organizations and community groups and sold to individuals at a modest fee ($25 or by donation) to cover the costs of updates, technical support, and an internship program which will send Balinese linguist students into elementary schools to teach Balinese, which so far has been taught with dated primers.

“This project will allow people to learn modern Balinese, since the Balinese language dictionaries available today are very traditional and have not developed in accordance with the progress of society and it will provide a new medium to learn the language, “says Windhu Sancaya, Professor at Lembaga Budaya Bali Institute.

As a result of this initiative, a new Balinese institute, Lembaga Budaya Bali, has been founded. The institute will sponsor internship programs for university students from Udayana and DwiJendra Universities to teach Balinese in elementary schools using these new materials and to work with Balinese teachers to create additional curriculum for the language.

For more information visit: [www.basabali.org](http://www.basabali.org/)
