# Vendor Hub

![](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0284/8545/1850/files/6_2048x2048.png?v=1761390418)

Welcome to the **General Collective Vendor Hub** — your go-to space for everything you need to prepare for upcoming markets and events that you're booked into.

Here you’ll find key event details, setup information, and helpful resources for our markets throughout the year — all in one convenient place.

We’ll be updating this page ahead of events, so be sure to bookmark it and check back regularly.

If you haven’t yet applied to be part of an upcoming event, take a moment to explore [**Showcasing Your Brand**](https://generalcollective.co.nz/pages/showcase-your-brand-with-general-collective "Showcasing your brand with General Collective | Benefits and demographics at events") — where you can discover the benefits of joining the General Collective community and gain insight into our event audiences. Or, head straight to the **[Apply Now](https://generalcollective.co.nz/pages/apply-for-general-collective-market "Apply for General Collective | Vendor Applications")** page to view current open events, stall pricing, and submit your online application.

![](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0284/8545/1850/files/1_82e6e01f-2660-4cba-a445-b726bf264388_600x600.png?v=1761390417)

#### **Vendor Facebook Group**

Join our [**Vendor Facebook Group**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/generalcollectivevendors) — a space to connect with fellow stallholders, share experiences, ask questions, and get quick responses from the **General Collective team**.

It’s also a great place to **search by topic** to find historic posts, tips, and inspiration — including photos of **[backdrops](https://www.facebook.com/groups/469664496746600/search?q=backdrop) and [stall setups](https://www.facebook.com/groups/469664496746600/search?q=stall)** from past events to help spark ideas for your own display.

We’ll continue posting important updates, reminders, and behind-the-scenes info here, so make sure you’re part of the conversation.

👉 Join the [Vendor Facebook Group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/generalcollectivevendors "General Collective Vendors Facebook Group")

![](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0284/8545/1850/files/3_600x600.png?v=1761390417)

#### **Vendor Portal Login**

 Login to the [**Vendor Portal**](https://portal.conventionforce.com/?aid=103) to apply to be part of our future markets plus update your contact details, web and social links, upload your logo, review important event information, download artwork, view map, upload product photos and product information. 

👉 Login to the [Vendor Portal](https://portal.conventionforce.com/?aid=103 "General Collective Vendor Portal") 

![](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0284/8545/1850/files/4_600x600.png?v=1761390417)

#### **Online Portal**

The **[Online Portal](https://generalcollective.co.nz/pages/online-map-vendor-line-up "General Collective Online Customer Portal | Map & Vendor List")[](https://generalcollective.co.nz/pages/online-map-vendor-line-up)** goes live in the week leading up to each event — giving customers the opportunity to explore our event line-up and connect directly with participating vendors.

Make the most of this visibility by ensuring your profile in our Vendor Portal is complete and polished. Upload:

*   High-quality product photos (No logo or text overlay, and no un cropped screenshots)
*   Clear product titles and descriptions
*   Your brand logo
*   Business description
*   Website and social media links

Everything you load on your profile is **visible to the public** (except your address and phone number), so take the time to make a great impression and showcase your brand at its best. 

👉 Visit the [Online Portal](https://generalcollective.co.nz/pages/online-map-vendor-line-up "General Collective Online Customer Portal | Map & Vendor List") for our recent and/or upcoming events

![](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0284/8545/1850/files/8_aaae115d-736b-4105-84b4-71aefdb6d027_600x600.png?v=1761391124)

#### **General Collective Lifestyle & Design Market**

Find everything you need to prepare for the **[_General Collective Lifestyle & Design Market_ - _Winter Edition_](https://www.facebook.com/share/1AbRCuTpiS/ "Vendor Hub | General Collective Lifestyle & Design Market | 9 August 2026 | Auckland Showgrounds")** _on_ **_9 August 2026_** at **_Auckland Showgrounds_**, including setup, parking, access, and key event-day details.

Access setup details, parking information, and key event-day resources all in one convenient place.

Inside you’ll find maps, artwork assets, and essential event information designed to make your market experience as smooth and successful as possible.

Discover all the key information for the **Ponsonby Market Day** on **Saturday 5 December 2026**, held along **Ponsonby Road** in partnership with _I Love Ponsonby_.

About transportation ### By car Be sure to purchase a Parking Tickets. ### Coming by Shinkansen Please use the shuttle bus from Echigoyuzawa Station(fee applies: ¥2,000 round trip). * The ride from the station to the venue takes about 40 minutes, but may take more than an hour during peak hours. * During busy times, you may have to wait for over an hour to board the bus, so please make sure you leave plenty of time. * If the shuttle bus is not running, you will not be able to return to Echigoyuzawa Station. ### Official Tour Bus Tour buses depart from 17 cities across the country and go directly to the venue. ▸Available at [official tour centers](https://www3.collaborationtours.com/fujirock/) . ## Q. Please be careful about the following items when bringing with you ### Hygiene SHOP Please prepare sufficient supplies of portable alcohol-based disinfectant, disinfectant wipes, and hygiene products. ### rain gear Don't bring a simple vinyl raincoat, but a sturdy one for camping or hiking (umbrellas are not permitted). ### Water Bottle We recommend a thermos bottle for cold or hot drinks. ### Hand towels It can be used for various purposes, such as sun protection, wiping sweat, and cooling down. ### Spare change of clothes For when it rains, you sweat, or you get muddy. ### shoes Comfortable sneakers, trekking shoes, boots, etc. that have good grip and can get dirty. ### hat A must-have for preventing sunburn and heatstroke. ### Winter clothes The event is held in the mountains at an altitude of 1,000m. The weather in the mountains is changeable and there are large temperature differences, so please prepare clothing that is easy to move in and suitable for all weather conditions, such as long-sleeved underwear, fleece, or a waterproof and breathable outer layer. ### Garbage bags (large and small sizes) Large garbage bags can be useful for storing things you don't want to get wet, such as clothes, or as sheets, depending on how you use them. ### Pocket tissues There may be no toilet paper in the Toilet. ### Simple first aid kit Blisters, cuts, etc. You may also be bitten by ticks and bees, so insect bite medicine is a must. Also, be prepared for sudden illness by bringing regular medicines such as headache medicine, cold medicine, and stomach medicine. ### Light A headlamp is useful as it frees up both hands. There are dark areas in the venue at night. ### Mobile battery There are no charging points inside the venue, so it's a good idea to bring a mobile battery to charge your smartphone. ### wallet Money/Credit card (electronic money can also be used) \*Electronic money payments cannot be made using overseas mobile phones inside the venue. It is convenient to have both hands free inside the venue. Please take care of your own luggage! ## Q: What kind of clothing should I wear? The venue is located in the mountains at an altitude of 1,000m. The weather in the mountains is changeable and there are large temperature differences, so please wear clothing that is easy to move in and suitable for all weather conditions. We recommend rainwear made of waterproof and breathable materials and trekking shoes with good grip. Unlike in the city, there are also many different insects living here, such as field mites and bees. To prevent insect bites, try to avoid exposing your skin as much as possible by wearing T-shirts, shorts, sandals, etc. # Manners inside the venue ## Q. Can I use tents, tarps, umbrellas, etc. inside the venue? Bringing or using tents, sunshades, tarps, parasols, blue tarps, etc. into the venue is prohibited. In recent years, abandoned tarps, sheets, chairs, etc. have become more common, and there are many situations where other customers cannot use these spaces even though they are available. To avoid confusion during crowded times and allow as many customers as possible to rest, we prohibit the bringing in and use of tents, sunshades, tarps, parasols, and other items that require a lot of space, as well as items that block the view. ## Q. Can I use seats or chairs inside the venue? It is prohibited to bring onto the premises blue tarps or other mats that require more space than the number of people using them, or collapsible outdoor chairs. Even if you bring your own mats or folding chairs, reserving or leaving them there is prohibited. Also, occupying space is not permitted. The use of mats and chairs is prohibited in the following areas: ### Prohibited areas * The entire RED MARQUEE area (including outside the tents) * In front of each stage's sound house and lighting tower, mosh pit * Kids Forest (A forest area within KIDS LAND) * Even if you are not in the above areas, please follow any instructions given by stage announcements or staff due to congestion. In recent years, there has been a noticeable increase in unoccupied seats and chairs, and there are many situations where other customers cannot use these seats even though they are available. To avoid confusion during busy times and allow more customers to rest, please be sure to pack up and take your seats and chairs with you when moving. ## Q. Can I bring a camera? You may bring in cameras and video cameras, but filming or recording the performing ARTISTS is prohibited. In addition, the use of selfie sticks will cause inconvenience to other customers, so their use is prohibited in front of the stage, when crowded, or while moving. ## Q. Can I bring in bottles and cans? Bottles and cans are prohibited from being brought into the venue. They cannot be brought in in cooler boxes either. For other prohibited items, please see the [Important Notices](https://en.fujirockfestival.com/attention/index) . ## Q. What are the smoking rules? Smoking is prohibited inside the venue. When smoking, please use the designated SMORKING AREA. ## Q. Can I bring my pet? Pets are not permitted inside the venue. ## Q. Can I use an umbrella inside the venue? Umbrellas are prohibited in all areas, including the Campsite. They reduce visibility and are very dangerous due to their protruding edges. Also, in bad weather, it can be blown away by the wind, so be sure to bring sturdy rain gear for camping and mountain climbing. ## Q. Can I sleep in the car? Yes, but please turn off the engine. In addition, please refrain from parking anywhere other than the parking lot to avoid causing inconvenience to local residents. In particular, please refrain from parking near national highways or store entrances. # Travelling with children or people with disabilities ## Q. From what age do children need an Festival Entry Ticket? This offer applies to individuals aged 15 or younger as of July 26, 2026. (Photo ID is required.) If you do not have a photo ID, please present two of the following: Student ID, Health Insurance Card, Maternal and Child Health Handbook, or Certificate of Residence. ## Q. Is there a place for children to play? "KIDS LAND" is located between the GREEN Stage and the WHITE Stage. In addition, we have a variety of activities in which parents and children can participate together. * We are unable to take care of children at all. ## Q. Are there any nursing facilities? For breastfeeding, diaper changes, etc., you can use KIDS LAND and the FIRST AID TENT. * It is not permitted to rest in the FIRST AID TENT or to look after children. * Diapers etc. will not be provided. Please bring your own. ## Q. Information for people with disabilities If you are a disabled person attending FUJI ROCK and are unable to see the performances on each stage, please speak to a member of staff at the sound and lighting control booth tents located on each stage and we will be happy to assist you. If you have a physical disability (or have a disability certificate) and are planning to attend FUJI ROCK, please contact us in advance using the details below. **Hot Staff Call Center** TEL: 050-5211-6077 (Weekdays 12:00-18:00) ## Q. Information on wheelchair-accessible facilities ### Wheelchair space behind the GREEN STAGE There is a space at the rear of the GREEN STAGE reserved for wheelchair users. * This space is only available for one accompanying person. * Only wheelchair users are permitted to use the facility. ### Private Toilet Wheelchair accessible Toilet are available throughout the venue. ## Q. Information about the priority tent A priority tent will be set up behind the GREEN STAGE for those who qualify. (Those who do not qualify cannot use this service.) * People with disabilities and their companions * Pregnant women and their companions * Preschool children and their guardians ### Important points to note when using this service * The priority tent is a "temporary rest" space. It can only be used for up to one hour at a time. * Those with a disability certificate can use the facility throughout the day. (If you do not have a disability certificate, you will not be eligible.) * Only one accompanying person or guardian is permitted. * Even if you have someone who falls under this category, you cannot use the facility as a group. * It is not permitted to leave any belongings or other items inside the priority tent when leaving. * Please check in at the priority tent entrance when using the facility. * Due to limited space, it may not be possible to use the facility during busy times. ## Q. Information about priority Toilet Each Toilet area has priority Toilet for people with disabilities, people with infants, children, pregnant women and the elderly. Anyone can use the priority Toilet, but please share them with other people if you are in a position where you would like to use them. # Related Services ## Q. Can I use courier service? **Only available within Japan. No shipping to or from overseas.** Delivery is available from home to venue or venue to home. In addition, if you are using an official tour bus, there is a courier service exclusively for tour bus passengers. For details, please check with the official tour center. #### Pre-delivery of luggage You can use Takkyubin to send your camping equipment and bulky items to the FUJI ROCK FESTIVAL venue in advance. You can send your parcel from Yamato Transport offices and courier service outlets (including convenience stores) nationwide! You can also request for collection from your home. **Yamato Transport Service Center** ▸ [0120-01-9625](tel:0120019625) (Toll-free/nationwide) #### Precautions * Things to keep in mind when packing Please do not bundle multiple items together or pack them together, but send each item individually with one shipping label attached to each package. (We are concerned that the package may become unpacked during transport, causing inconvenience to our customers.) * Please allow ample time for shipping. To ensure smooth delivery of your package, please ship your package by 7/18(Sat). * Please send any luggage to the venue by cash on delivery so that no settlement is required at the venue. * Please note that we cannot handle refrigerated delivery or time-specified delivery. * Please keep the "client copy" safe and do not lose it, and be sure to bring it with you to the venue. It is required to exchange your luggage. * Please note that some items cannot be delivered due to their shape or contents, so please check in advance. * The delivery service is a contract between the customer and the shipping company, so the FUJI ROCK FESTIVAL festival will not be held responsible for any accidents that occur during delivery. * If you have any other questions, please contact your delivery company. #### How to fill out a slip | | | | --- | --- | | Destination | Postal code 949-6212

Is there a place to store luggage? Coin lockers and luggage storage are available in the off-site shopping area. #### coin lockers Fee: ¥500/¥400/Available 24 hours (fees apply per use) * Only 100 yen coins (cash) are accepted. * There are no currency exchange machines available. #### Luggage storage Fee: ¥1,500 (1 day/1 item) Deposits and withdrawals are possible 7/24 (Fri) 7:00 - 7/27 (Mon): 24 hours. 7/27 (Mon) until 12:00 PM. **《Caution》** * We cannot accept valuables, cash, dangerous items, or fragile items. * Please check other precautions on-site. ## Q. Is there mobile phone reception? It will connect, but it may be difficult to connect depending on usage conditions. Signal conditions vary depending on the carrier. ## Q. Is there anywhere I can charge my cell phone? This is not provided as a service by the organizers. (This may be available at some participating stores.) ## Q. Can I use credit cards or electronic money? The following payment services can be used at restaurants and MERCHANDISE BOOTHS. * **Credit card** AMERICAN EXPRESS / VISA / MASTER / JCB * **Electronic money** Kitaca / PASMO / Suica / manaca / TOICA / ICOCA / Hayakaken / nimoca / SUGOCA nanaco / WAON / QUICPay / iD * **QR code** auPay / PayPay / dPayment / R Pay * Cash is also accepted. * If QR code payment takes time due to signal strength, we may ask you to use an alternative payment method. # Campsite ## Q. What do I need for camping? ### tent A sturdy, waterproof bag for camping and hiking. \*If this is your first time setting up a tent, we recommend that you try it out yourself before coming. This will give you practice, as you may have to set up in bad weather. It will also allow you to check that there are no defects with the tent accessories. ### sleeping bag The temperature drops considerably at night, so we recommend bringing something that can withstand the cold. ### Seats and Mats Every year, there are many cases of tents flooding due to rain. To prevent water seepage, lay a sheet on the outside of the tent and a mat on the inside. \*The use of tarps is prohibited. ## Q. Are there Toilet and showers at the Campsite ? Yes, there is. Please check the location on the map on the day. ## Q. How should I eat at the Campsite? There are food and drink stalls in the Campsite area and outside the grounds, some of which are open from the morning. * The use of fire is prohibited on the Campsite, and cooking is not permitted outside of the barbecue area. (At the Auto-camp area"MOON CARAVAN," you can cook in your own area.) ## Q. How to avoid attracting wild animals Wild animals are strongly attracted to the smell of food. Please note the following: * Do not leave food or drinks inside the tent. * Please separate your trash and take it to the eco-station. * Please do not leave food or empty containers around your tent. ## Q. What should I do if I get injured at the Campsite? Please consult the information desk at the Campsite or the nearest aid station. ## Q. Is there a place to charge my cell phone on the Campsite? The Campsite does not provide power services such as charging spots. We recommend bringing a mobile battery or similar. (Generators are not permitted.) ## Q. Can I use an umbrella inside the Campsite? Umbrellas are prohibited in all areas, including Campsite. ## Q. What are the smoking rules within the Campsite? The Campsite is non-smoking. When smoking, please use the designated SMORKING AREA. ## Q. Can I bring pets to the Campsite? Pets are not allowed inside. (However, only dogs are allowed in the Auto-camp area"MOON CARAVAN" and the "dog run.") ## Q. Can I use skateboards at the Campsite? You cannot bring or use any electronic devices into the venue, including the Campsite. Bicycles and other vehicles are also not permitted. There is no bicycle parking area. ## Q. Can I leave my tent out when I go to see a live show? yes. Please do not leave any valuables inside your tent. Please be sure to store and carry them at your own risk. We are not responsible for any theft or loss. Also, when leaving your tent, please be sure to lock the door securely and make sure that the tent ropes and pegs are securely fastened. * The Campsite is very large and there are many similar tents, so every year many people lose track of where they pitched their tent. Please be sure to mark your own tent with some kind of strategy. # Others ## Q. Regarding JR Echigoyuzawa Station Echigoyuzawa Station will be closed from midnight to 5:30 a.m. During this time, no one will be allowed inside the station. ## Q. Regarding parking * Please refrain from parking on the national highway or around the parking lots before they open as this will cause inconvenience to local residents. Please arrive at the opening time. * Please arrive within the valid time of each parking lot. * Please refrain from parking in a way that causes inconvenience to neighbors. ## Q. Can I throw away trash? There are trash cans operated by volunteer staff at the venue, Campsite, etc. Please do not litter, but take your trash to the nearest trash can. However, please be sure to take home any sheets, chairs, tents, etc. that you bring with you. The original garbage bags distributed at the entrance gate and the toilet paper provided at the venue are made from recycled materials that were carefully sorted by visitors last year. Please help us sort our trash so that we can carry on this tradition into next year. ## Q. What kinds of animals live around the venue? The FUJI ROCK Festival venue and surrounding area are located in a rich natural environment, and there is a possibility of encountering wild animals such as bears, monkeys, and wild boars. For your safety, please take the following precautions. ### Regarding behavior inside the venue * Wild animals are strongly attracted to the smell of food. Leaving food or garbage unintentionally can attract wild animals, so please be sure to take your food waste to the eco-station. * Please do not enter restricted areas. * Customers with children are requested to keep their children within sight at all times and refrain from letting them act independently. ### Efforts to ensure safety At FUJI ROCK, to ensure the safety of all attendees, experts will be used to deter wild animals from the area around the venue before and during the event, and monitors will be patrolling the area. We will also issue warnings as needed, and we appreciate your understanding and cooperation. ## Q. What kinds of insects live there? What are some preventative measures? Unlike in the city, there are insects such as bees, flies, mosquitoes, and gnats living here. Before the event, we will go around the venue and remove any dangerous beehives, but it is impossible to remove everything, so please be careful. Also, at venues surrounded by nature, you need to be careful of unexpected insect bites. * Please prepare medicine to prevent insect bites in advance. * Please do not enter the restricted areas or deep within the forest. #### Preventive measures to avoid bee stings * Do not approach the hive (as long as you do not get too close, they will not attack you unexpectedly). * Wear clothing that fits snugly against your skin to prevent bees from getting under your clothes. * Avoid yellow or dark clothing and hats (especially yellow and black striped patterns are the most dangerous). * Avoid strong-smelling perfumes and cosmetics. * If a bee is flying around you, move away slowly and quietly. * If you get too close, crouch down. Due to the nature of bees, there is a chance that you may be able to escape their sight. * White hats and clothing are said to be relatively safe. #### Preventive measures against tick bites Unlike house mites, large field mites parasitize and feed on the blood of medium to large animals (rabbits, deer, etc.) to lay eggs. If a human happens to come into contact with a field mites, they will be bitten and suffer damage. If you are bitten by a field tick, it only causes a slight itch and pain, so you may be inclined to treat it yourself, but please be aware that if the field tick is carrying a pathogen, it can cause infectious diseases such as scrub typhus or Lyme disease, which can worsen your overall condition and cause skin symptoms, fever, facial nerve paralysis, etc. * Wear light-colored clothing with a smooth, fine weave. * Wear clothes that fit snugly against the skin to prevent the virus from getting inside your clothes (including tucking the bottoms into high-top shoes or knee-high socks). * When you return to Lodging, check for signs of field mites, ticks on your clothes, hair, and bites on your head. * If you find a bite, do not crush the insect, but pull it out with tweezers or something similar (preferably within 4 hours). # FAQ * [First-time visitors](https://en.fujirockfestival.com/faq/index#faq1) * [Manners inside the venue](https://en.fujirockfestival.com/faq/index#faq2) * General Collective, established in 2014, delivers a range of up-scale markets, collaborates with businesses to deliver events, provides publicity and increased traffic to' premises, and hosts interactive pop-up shops within retail spaces.  

Our flagship, stand-alone event - [General Collective Lifestyle & Design Market](https://generalcollective.co.nz/pages/lifestyle-and-design-market "General Collective Lifestyle & Design Market") - held at the Auckland Showgrounds two times per year with hundreds of vendors showcasing New Zealand-made or designed products, amazing street food vendors, and thousands of visitors. 

![](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0284/8545/1850/files/8_aaae115d-736b-4105-84b4-71aefdb6d027_2048x2048.png?v=1761391124)

Ongoing collaborations and sought-after events have been established with a number of businesses and precincts including Ponsonby Central and Morningside Precinct.

General Collective has also delivered a range of one-off targeted events in a collaborative manner with Auckland Council (Panuku), New Zealand Fashion Week, SkyCity, Eden Park (Campbell & Co) and City Works Depot.  

With a background in event management spanning 20 + years, Rose Barbarich have a passion for delivering seamless events and activations ensuring a curated offering of vendors and a beautiful showcase for customers. 

If you’re excited about a possible collaboration with General Collective, [get in touch with us today](mailto:rose@generalcollective.co.nz "Contact | General Collective").

![Ponsonby Central](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0284/8545/1850/files/gc_190609_011_copy_3de1aaa9-5167-4f8c-a88a-19a674912573_2048x2048.jpg?v=1645142866)

**_"General Collective started a relationship with Ponsonby Central, Auckland in 2015 that has continued to strengthen and expand._**

**_They always include the perfect curation of vendors, attention to detail, and most importantly, they support unique and creative local businesses._**

**_They have such a large and loyal following, it's not hard to see why."_** 

\- Sarah Wickenden, Marketing Manager, [Ponsonby Central](https://www.ponsonbycentral.co.nz/ "Ponsonby Central")

![Milford Centre](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0284/8545/1850/files/GC_01.11.2020_133_lowrez_2048x2048.jpg?v=1646881921)

## COLLABORATIVE MARKETS 

Ongoing collaborations and sought-after markets and events have been created and delivered by General Collective for:

**Ponsonby Central**  

*   _Ponsonby Central Market | Established 2015, Twice yearly_

**Morningside Precinct**

*   _Glasshouse Market | 2018 - 2023_
*   _Botanical Market | 2020 - 2023_

**Milford Centre**

*   _Milford Centre Market | 2020 - 2021_ 

**Ellerslie Business Association**

*   _Kids Market | 2016 - 2025, Annually_

**GridAKL Generator**  

*   _Generator Market | 2017 - 2019_  

![Eden Park](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0284/8545/1850/files/GC_2020_20_12_013_lowrez_2048x2048.jpg?v=1646882809)

## COLLABORATIVE PROJECTS

One-off targeted collaborative events & showcase projects have been delivered for: 

[**Kings Plant Barn**](https://generalcollective.co.nz/pages/kings-plant-barn-stonefields "Kings Plant Barn Stonefields")

*   _Instore & online designer showcase for the new concept store Kings Plant Barn Stonefields | 2022, 6 Month Showcase_

**Auckland Council**

**Eden Park & Sky (Managed by Campbell & Co)**

__**New Zealand Fashion Week**__

**SkyCity**

If you’d like to showcase your brand to our highly-engaged following you can [apply here](https://portal.conventionforce.com/?aid=103).

![Ambury Farm Day](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0284/8545/1850/files/191020GC_025_lowrez_2048x2048.jpg?v=1646884537)

### [VENDOR PORTAL LOGIN](https://portal.conventionforce.com/?aid=103)

[Login](https://portal.conventionforce.com/?aid=103 "General Collective Vendor Portal Login") to the Vendor Portal to apply to be part of our future markets plus update contact details and social links, upload your logo, review important event information, download artwork, view map, upload product photos and product information. 

![](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0284/8545/1850/files/GCLD_Nov_2024_a_026_1cb9c458-7c92-4ea7-992a-4ba5a13f963f_2048x2048.jpg?v=1757782474)

### [NEW TEXT MESSAGE (SMS) FEATURE](https://portal.conventionforce.com/?aid=103)

As part of our ongoing efforts to enhance communication and ensure that you as a vendor stay informed about important updates regarding General Collective events, we are excited to introduce a new feature that allows you to receive key information via text messages (SMS).

To take advantage of this service and opt in to receive text messages, follow these simple steps:

[Login](https://portal.conventionforce.com/?aid=103 "General Collective Vendor Portal Login") to the Vendor Portal > navigate to the main menu > click on "Opt In."

Under the "Receive text messages" section, select "Yes" to subscribe to SMS updates.

ドイツ・カッセルで開催された「documenta fifteen」でのCINEMA CARAVANの活動とルアンルパの思想を記録した作品。地域と地域、人と人がつながり、それぞれの場所で文化や場をつくっていくという、自分たちが大切にしてきたことにもつながる作品です。
第2部は、notremusica orchestraのLIVE。
こちらもこれだけのメンバーが揃って演奏すること自体なかなかない機会です。大編成ならではの生の音を、ぜひホールで体感してください。スペシャルゲストにkom\_Iの参加も決まっています。
そして中学生以下は無料！
楽器を習っている子どもたちにも、きっと良い刺激になると思います。ぜひご家族でも。
さらにチケット購入者には、今年のZAFメイン会場「本田邸」の無料入場チケットも付いてきます。
せっかく実現したこの機会、できるだけ多くの人に観てもらいたいです。
いろいろなイベントが重なっている10月3日ですが、ぜひお誘い合わせの上見に来てください。

10月3日（土）に文化プラザホールで開催される「ZAF2026 OPENING ACT」に、KOM\_I（コムアイ）、青森うぐいす姉妹のスペシャルゲストとしての参加が決定しました！
CINEMA CARAVAN/CINEMA AMIGOの長島 源が共同代表を務める『逗子アートフェスティバル(ZAF)』。
ZAF2026の幕開けを彩る、特別な一夜です。 志津野雷による『beyond documenta fifteen』の上映と生演奏に加え、さらにスペシャルゲストを迎えて、オープニングを盛り上げます。
ぜひ会場で、この日限りの時間をお楽しみください。
Special GUEST（第2部）
◾️KOM\_I（アーティスト・歌手） 声を主に用いて表現活動を行う。日本の郷土芸能や民俗学、北インドの古典音楽に影響を受けている。 主な音楽作品に、オオルタイチと制作した『YAKUSHIMA TREASURE』や、食品まつりa.k.a foodmanと発表した『FANI MANI』。気候危機について歌った『なんか地球がおかしい』など。
◾️青森うぐいす姉妹 800年の伝統を持つ南部手踊り発祥の地、青森県南部町生まれ。 姉・西塚繭子、妹・西塚淳子ともに3歳から民謡を習い、民謡と南部手踊りの世界で、史上初となる姉妹での全国チャンピオンを成し遂げる。 唄い、踊り、三味線を弾く。 幼い頃から身体に染み込んだ南部の芸を、姉妹ならではの息の合った舞台で届けている。
西塚淳子 第63代青森県民謡王座、第11回南部七踊り全国大会優勝ほか、数々の大会で優勝。 津軽三味線世界大会の唄付けや、南部七踊り全国大会などの本部伴奏を務める。全国200件以上の福祉施設を訪問し、フィリピン公演では4,000人を動員。 民謡、津軽三味線、南部手踊り。それぞれの師匠から受け継いだ技術と精神を忠実に表現しながら、三つの芸を自在に操る、確かな実力を持つ総合芸能者。
西塚繭子 第31代青森県手踊り名人位、第69代青森県民謡王座。南部手踊り全国大会優勝ほか、数々の大会で受賞。 女性として史上初となる「青森県手踊り名人位」と「青森県民謡王座」の二冠を成し遂げる。 活動の拠点を関東に移し、民謡や踊りに興味を持つ全国のミュージシャンやダンサーなどの民謡とは異なるジャンルの表現者にも積極的に指導し、日本の魂を覚醒させている。 伝統とは、革新を続けること 今回のオーケストラと南部民謡の共演は目指す革新そのものです。

プログラム・出演者紹介
『beyond documenta fifteen』（監督：志津野雷） “アートのオリンピック”とも呼ばれる国際芸術祭「documenta fifteen」。全体キュレーターのルアンルパへのインタビューを軸に、CINEMA CARAVAN×栗林隆の実践と「NO ART MAKE FRIENDS」の思想が響き合う姿を、notremusica orchestraの生演奏とともに上映予定。
志津野 雷 写真家・映像作家。世界各地を旅しながら自然、文化、人々の営みを撮影し、写真・映像作品を発表。2010年、逗子を拠点にCINEMA CARAVANを立ち上げる。映画、音楽、食、アートを横断し、地域と世界をつなぐ表現の場を国内外で展開している。
辰田 翔 / notremusica orchestra 作曲、ピアノ、哲学を学ぶ。自身のオーケストラ『NMO』で作曲・指揮・ピアノを担当。ファッション、映画、広告、自治体、芸術祭などへ幅広く音楽・音響作品を提供する。美術分野でも映像、空間、インスタレーション、立体造形、建築など多角的な作品制作を行っている。

FAQ

当サイトや公式SNSに個人の方から様々なお問い合わせをいただいておりますが、  
個々のご質問全てにお答えしかねますことをご了承ください。  
なお、いくつか重複したお問い合わせもございますので、こちらでお答えさせていただきます。

*   コンビニ支払いで支払い期限が過ぎてしまったら？
    
    支払い期限までにコンビニでのお支払いが完了してない場合、お申し込みされたチケットは無効となります。完売してしまったチケットの再販はありませんのでご注意下さい。
    
*   チケットはいつから販売ですか？
    
    公開をお待ちください。
    
*   当日券はありますか？
    
    一般の当日券はございません。
    
    必ず前売りチケットをご購入の上ご来場ください。  
    逗子市民のみ身分証明書を提示の上購入できるチケットがございます。（お連れ様で市外の方の分はご購入いただけません。ご本人のみとなります）
    
*   チケットは出入り自由なの？
    
    ご入場時にリストバンドを着用して頂きます。出入りの際には係員によりリストバンドをチェックさせて頂きます。尚リストバンドは当日のみ有効となります。紛失された場合の再発行は出来かねますのでご注意下さい。
    
*   誤ってリストバンドを外してしまった場合には
    
    いかなる理由にかかわらず、リストバンドの破損、紛失に伴う再発行は一切致しません。リストバンドを着用していない場合はご入場いただけませんので、フェスティバル終了まで大切にお取り扱いいただき、絶対にはずさないようお願い致します。また、不正入場が発覚した場合、いかなる理由にかかわらず退場して頂きます。その場合、身柄を警察に引き渡した上で、法的措置を取らせていただきますので、予めご了承ください。
    
*   映画を観る前に帰る場合でもチケットは必要なの？
    
    はい、チケットは映画鑑賞料ではなく入場料としていただいております。途中おかえりいただく方も含め終日入場料をいただいております。
    
*   早めに行って場所取りをしてもいいの？
    
    上映前のお時間は場所取りのみの行為はおやめください。上映時間もたくさんのお客様が気持ちよく映画をご覧いただけるよう常識の範囲でご配慮くださいますようお願いします。ビーチチェア・テントのご使用はお控えください。
    
*   雨天でも開催するのですか？
    
    雨天でも開催します。強風、大雨の場合は安全を考慮し中止になる場合がございます。本サイトNews、公式SNS等でご確認下さい。
    
    \-中止の目安-  
    強風、大雨、雷、洪水、波浪等各種警報が発令されるとき・風速10m以上の 強風が一定時間継続して吹くとき等の荒天時は中止いたします。  
    その他、会場の様子などで中止の判断となる場合もございますので、公式サイトなどで情報をご確認ください。
    
*   駐車場はありますか？
    
    駐車場のご用意はございません。最寄りのコインパーキングをご利用下さい。GWは大変込み合いますので、公共の交通機関のご利用をお勧め致します。
    
*   準備していった方がいい物はありますか？
    
    夜は大変冷え込みます、昼間が暖かい日でも防寒具をご用意してきてください。  
    夜間ですと寒い日で2月下旬ごろの気温（10℃前後）まで冷え込む事もございます。  
    ブルゾン、ダウンなど厚手のもの、ブランケット等・レインコートをご持参ください。
    
*   持ち込み禁止のものはありますか？
    
    ご飲食物・花火、爆竹等の危険物など、周囲のお客様のご迷惑になる物に関してもお持込みできません。
    
*   飲食物の持ち込みはできますか？
    
    お持ち込みはお断りさせていただいております。  
    飲食物の持込は、一切お断りしております。スタッフが発見次第、没収、破棄させていただく場合もございますのでご了承下さい。
    
*   落し物などはどこに問い合わせたらいいですか？
    
    開催当日は、会場エントランスにてお問い合わせください。  
    イベント終了後は、直接（[info@zushifilm.com](mailto:info@zushifilm.com)）にお問い合わせください。  
    （お電話での受付はおこなっておりません）  
    落し物の保管、お問い合わせのご対応は会期終了後1ヶ月間です。  
    金銭、貴重品等の紛失に関しては当方では責任を負いかねますのでご了承下さい。
    
*   犬は一緒に入れますか？
    
    ペットの同伴は禁止ではありませんが、大勢のお客様がいらっしゃいますので必ずリードなどをつけて離さないようお願い致します。  
    また、上映中に大きな声で吠えたり他の来場者の方に迷惑がかかるようなことがあった場合には残念ですがご退場いただくこともあるかと思います。
    
*   会場内で荷物は預けられますか？
    
    会場内にはクロークはございません。  
    京急「逗子・葉山駅」のコインロッカー等ご利用下さい。
    
*   スケートランプで怪我をしたり、させてしまった場合は？
    
    スケートランプでの走行中の事故・負傷等について主催者・会場側は一切責任を負いませんのであらかじめご了承の上、ランプでの走行や観賞をお楽しみください。事故等の問題があった場合には、必ず当事者間で解決していただき、主催者はその協議など、問題解決には一切関与致しませんので、予めご了承ください。
    
*   会場周辺の施設・植物を破損させてしまったら？
    
    会場は公共の海岸となります。マナーを守り近隣住宅など、周囲の迷惑になるような行為、（器物破損・ゴミの投棄・駅から会場までのスケートボードでの走行・会場周辺の植栽物を傷つける行為・路上で大声を出したり、携帯スピーカー等で音楽を流す行為）はお止め下さい。

# Contact Us

# Contact

We’d love to hear from you and will respond as soon as we can. Remember, we’re all volunteers and sometimes it could take a while to get back to you, so make sure you _**look on the website for the information you need first.**_ And you’ll get a quicker response if you choose the right department for your query from the **drop down list below**.

**Volunteering for ALL departments is coordinated by the Volunteer Team, not directly through each department.** [Read more and apply here](https://kiwiburn.com/participate/volunteer/).

To help you choose the best fit to send your query to, read below:

###### What's your query about? who should you send it to?

*   **ExCom:** You need to talk about policy, complaints, administration.
*   **Volunteer:** You want to volunteer – yay! [Read more and apply here](https://kiwiburn.com/participate/volunteer/).
*   **Tickets:** You read the [webpage](https://kiwiburn.com/prepare/tickets/) and still have a question.
*   **Media Liaison:** You are a Media representative or have a graphic design, writing, blogs or newsletter enquiry.
*   **Theme Camps:** You want to contact the Theme Camp and Sound Camp Coordinator.
*   **Art Grants:** You read the [webpages](https://kiwiburn.com/participate/art/) and still have a question.
*   **Greeters:** You read the [webpage](https://kiwiburn.com/about/volunteer-teams/) and still have a question.
*   **Gate:** You read the [webpage](https://kiwiburn.com/about/volunteer-teams/) and still have a question.
*   **Black Sheep Rangers:** You read the [webpage](https://kiwiburn.com/about/volunteer-teams/) and still have a question.
*   **MPW:** You read the [webpage](https://kiwiburn.com/about/volunteer-teams/) and still have a question.
*   **Community Engagement Lead:** You read the [KB-log](https://kiwiburn.com/community-engagement-lead/) and now want to share something with the community.
*   **Centre Camp Coordinator:** You want to chat to the team about hosting an event at the Centre Camp.
*   **Town Planning:** You want to contact the Town Planning Coordinator
*   **Photography Liaison:** You’ve read the guidelines though are keen to know more.
*   **IT Team:** You found something on the site that needs fixing? Let the IT team know.
*   **Conduct Committee:** You wish to get in touch with the Conduct Committee. **If you wish to CONFIDENTIALLY report an incident requiring investigation** **please email the Conduct Committee directly [here,](mailto:conductcommittee@kiwiburn.com)** rather than using the drop down menu. Read the Conduct Committee guidelines [here](https://kiwiburn.com/conduct-committee/).
*   **10 year pins:** You’ve been coming to Kiwiburn on and off for 10 years now and want to wear it with pride with a 10 year pin. Apply for one here.

About

「逗子海岸映画祭」とは、『 Play with the Earth 』をコンセプトに、世界を旅する「 CINEMA CARAVAN 」が創る、ゴールデンウィークに逗子の砂浜に現れるスペシャルな空間。

自然の中で人々とカルチャーがリアルに交わるプラットフォームとして、日常は静かな逗子海岸に、「CINEMA CARAVAN」と、これまで出会ったコミュニティの人々と、ローカルコミュニティが共同で創っています。13日間の会期終了には、また静かな逗子海岸へと戻っていく、期間限定の映画祭です。

日中は、縁ある人たちによる日替りのフードにBAZAARやさまざまなアクティビティ、そして黄昏に染まる日没とともに始まる海辺での映画体験は、人生を彩る思い出の一つとなるでしょう。

日々変化する海辺の自然環境の中で五感をフルに使ってカラダ全部で楽しみ、地球を感じ、地球と遊ぶ。

「CINEMA CARAVAN」が表現する、ローカルの繋がりと国内外の地域交流のコミュニティから生まれた温かい空間をぜひお楽しみください。

(Please turn off the engine.) ## Access methods * **Kan-etsu Expressway"Tsukiyono IC " to National Route 17, 33km** Tsukiyono IC is convenient for customers with a 3Day S/A Parking Ticket. * **Kan-etsu Expressway"Yuzawa IC " - National Route 17 21km** Yuzawa IC is convenient for customers with a 1day Parking Ticket. ## Parking * **3Day pass (S Parking Ticket):** On-No.1 Festival Parking Area * **3Day pass (A Parking Ticket):** Parking available near the venue within walking distance * **One-day Parking Ticket:** off-site parking * Guests using the off-site parking can use the Shuttle Bus between the off-site parking and the venue. (The round-trip bus fare is included in the Parking Ticket.) * Parking spaces for 3Day (A Parking Ticket) and 1Day Parking Tickets will be allocated by the festival (cannot be specified). ### Note * Purchase a Parking Tickets together with Festival Entry Ticket for two or more people. Parking Tickets cannot be purchased separately, so you cannot purchase them later. [Parking Tickets details](https://en.fujirockfestival.com/ticket/index) # Official Tour Bus **Recommended for first-time participants!** The official tour center offers tour buses that go directly to the venue from 17 cities across the country. Choose the bus that best suits your style of participation, including late-night departures from the venue and plans that are more economical than the Shinkansen. There is also a courier service exclusively for tour bus passengers, so you can participate light and easily. ## Exclusive service for tour bus users * There is a wristband exchange counter and courier service desk exclusively for tour bus passengers, so you can complete all your procedures at the bus stop. * PYRAMID GARDEN is a flat grassy Campsite a one-minute walk from the bus stop and is a camping area exclusively for tour bus passengers. [PYRAMID GARDEN, a Campsite exclusively for tour bus passengers](https://www3.collaborationtours.com/fujirock/pickup/pyramidgarden.html) ## Under 22 (Value) Plan Those under 22 years old can use the Campsite for free when using the tour bus round trip (usually a Campsite Tickets is required). Additionally, if you use the tour bus round trip, you will receive a 1,000 yen food voucher for use at the venue. [Under 22 (Discount) Camping Tickets](https://www3.collaborationtours.com/fujirock/pickup/under22.html) ### Tour bus departure and arrival points * **Kanto Area** Shinjuku/Ikebukuro/Tokyo/Haneda/Yokohama/Funabashi/Omiya/Hachioji * **Kansai/ Chugoku** Kyoto/Osaka/Sannomiya * **Tokai and Chubu** Shizuoka/Nagoya * **Tohoku** Sendai * **Niigata** Niigata/Nagaoka \*Connects to Jomo Kogen Station (Shinkansen)! No waiting time, reservation required. Jomo Kogen Station Access bus also available. ### Sales Schedule | | | | --- | --- | | 1st Period

You can apply for transportation, Lodging, and TICKETS purchases in one step. **Travel Planning and Implementation Collaboration, Inc.** Inquiries regarding tours (travel) ▸ [03-6859-6969](tel:03-6859-6969) Call center hours: Monday to Friday 11:00 to 16:00 \*Closed on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays ▸ fujirock@collaborationtours.com (PC/mobile inquiries accepted) ### Note * There are limited seats on the bus and limited rooms available at the Lodging. [Official Tour Center](https://www3.collaborationtours.com/fujirock/) ### For those applying from overseas At the FRF OFFICIAL SHOP GAN-BAN, we offer a limited number of direct buses and optional services that can be applied for from overseas. * Tour bus departing from Shinjuku and going directly to the venue * Rental tent plan that does not require setup or removal * Lodging Plan **Details and application** [FRF OFFICIAL SHOP GAN-BAN](https://ganban.net/?p=78374) * Only those who have applied for the direct bus between Shinjuku and Tokyo and the rental tents to be set up at PYRAMID GARDEN can use the PYRAMID GARDEN Campsite. # Bullet Train **Recommended for those who want to make the most of their time at the venue!** It takes about an hour and a half on the Joetsu Shinkansen from Tokyo Station to Echigo Echigoyuzawa Station ! There are many buses running and it's easy to fit them into your schedule, so if you use the courier service you can go straight there after work. ### Access methods **Get off at JR East"Echigoyuzawa Station"** | | | | --- | --- | | Echigoyuzawa Station and Naeba Venue
Shuttle Bus service (approx. 40 minutes) | Ticket: ¥2,000

* This ticket can be used once for both a round trip and a return trip.
* Valid only during the FUJI ROCK Festival period, including the date of purchase.
* If you are coming from JR Echigoyuzawa Station, please pay 2,000 yen when you board.
* If you are coming from the Naeba venue, please present your ticket.
* If you do not have a ticket, please inform a member of staff and pay the 2,000 yen fare at JR Echigoyuzawa Station.
* There will be no refunds or deductions for unused portions. | | Echigoyuzawa Station → Festival Grounds
Fast Bus with Advance Reservation | Advance reservations are required for specified dates and times.

(The fare for the return Shuttle Bus is included in the fare for the fast bus.) | \*In addition to the Joetsu Shinkansen, the Joetsu Line and Hokuetsu Express Hokuhoku Line are also available. ### Note * After the show ends, you will not be able to catch the last train from Echigoyuzawa Station. # History of Kiwiburn

![2015 Effigy fire performances](https://kiwiburn.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/15751628534_14e448a3c5_h.jpg "15751628534_14e448a3c5_h")

# History of Kiwiburn

Mark ‘Yonderman’ Stirling’s lengthy association with Burning Man began while he was living in Reno, Nevada doing his PhD. He and his partner Jane discovered Burning Man by accident in 1994 while on a camping trip in the Black Rock Desert. Mark became the New Zealand Regional representative and after a few years, decided to stage the first regional burn in New Zealand. At that time, few New Zealanders had actually attended Burning Man, so he chose the South Island’s [Visionz festival](https://web.archive.org/web/20041204185511/http://www.visionz.org.nz/) as it had a similar emphasis on Burning Man philosophies such as ‘leave no trace’ and subsistence culture.

The early 2004 event was met with great enthusiasm from the participants, who had either heard of Burning Man previously, had seen the various pamphlets and posters around the festival, or had just decided to join in on the fun.

The overall success of the inaugural New Zealand regional event encouraged Mark to stage stand-alone burns the following two years in the South Island, and attracted approximately 200 people. Mark co-ran these events with Grant ‘Tribalman’ Knowles, a friend and local drum-maker/festival organiser.

In mid-2006, amidst the planning for the 2007 event, a group of highly enthused, motivated burners joined with Yonderman to form an organisational structure and bring the event north. The event was aptly named Megamorphosis, which means Massive Change. Kiwiburn took off to become a significant regional sensation, and has created a community of burners for burners and friends. A team of devoted and talented Kiwiburners from around the country now organise Kiwiburn.

These people had a vision of what a New Zealand burner event could be like, and the people who came not knowing a thing about the culture of Burning Man continue to embrace it, and want more. So much pride has been exhibited among the attendees, that this amazing event could happen here in New Zealand, and it gets better every year. Major thanks go out to the locals – the firemen, the farmers, and the local council representatives – who come to the event and contribute hugely. Kiwiburn would not be as successful without them.

New Zealanders have since readily embraced the concept and spectacle of Burning Man and Kiwiburn. For more information and to keep up to date with the New Zealand regional group, write to [newzealand@burningman.com](mailto:newzealand@burningman.com) and check out the rest of our website.

We hope that many more local and overseas guests will join us in New Zealand for future Kiwiburns – bigger, brighter, louder, friendlier and more magical then ever before. Information and reviews of subsequent Kiwiburns can be found in the annual [Afterburn Report](https://kiwiburn.com/afterburn), and a selection of photos and videos can be viewed in our Gallery pages.

# Year-Round Volunteer Roles

# Volunteering Opportunities

#### Year-Round, Lead, and Team Roles

**We need YOU!** Kiwiburn is always looking for volunteers at every level, from [onsite shifts during the event](https://app.kiwiburn.com/onsite-volunteers) [](https://app.kiwiburn.com/onsite-volunteers)through to year-round team members, team leaders, and department facilitators. 

We have some specific year-round roles that need filling; if you have the time, energy, relevant skills and experience, and are keen to be more involved, read the job descriptions below to find out which role would suit you. 

If you’re wondering how an event of this size can be run entirely by volunteers, and where you might fit in, you should delve into the [Kiwiburn Organisational Structure](https://kiwiburn.com/about/the-organisation/how-it-works/) and find out how everything works around here!

## Featured role

## Featured role

### [Infrastructure Facilitator (ExCom Role)](https://kiwiburn.com/wp-json/role-jds/v1/recH3tD1cJiKGSWAe/Infrastructure+Facilitator)

Do you like Power… I mean Real Power, not like those DoP peeps pretend to have. Power made by a generator and held closely and nurtured by BESS, our giant powerbank, then distributed wide to our site, you know Real Power!!! We are looking for the next human to look after 5 fantastic Infrastructure teams. Oh and fighting, do you like fighting?? To paraphase Keanu “If you don’t fight for your Teams, what kind of Teams do you have?”

We have Great Infrastructure teams and they make sure our Town:  
– Is planned, accessible, signposted and Fabulous  
– Has beautifully manicured roads and sites  
– Has Poopers that are serviced 4 times a day for that fresh flushed feeling  
– Is built to the DoBro Red Standard  
– And last but not least makes sure after you have cleaned up, your tidying meets the White Glove standard we expect to leave our town in until next year

So if you would like to lead these fantastic teams, wrangle some suppliers and make sure your teams can continue to do the things they do to cries of “Love Your Work” and “Tidy Job”, become our new Infrastructure Facilitator.

[Apply now](https://airtable.com/appDlV9Elu7XhmaZJ/shr2eJ5RGE2AdDMOO)

[Read the job description](https://kiwiburn.com/wp-json/role-jds/v1/recH3tD1cJiKGSWAe/Infrastructure+Facilitator)

### [Community Facilitator (ExCom Role)](https://kiwiburn.com/wp-json/role-jds/v1/recmhXwyPIG9NygFx/Community+Facilitator)

This is your chance to be the voice of the people. The Community Facilitator sits at the heart of Kiwiburn’s relationship with its community — championing diversity and inclusion, upholding te Tiriti o Waitangi, nurturing our connection with Ngati Hauiti, and keeping the Burning Man Principles alive and well in Aotearoa.

You’ll lead the CommuniTEAM, Consent Culture, and Data Analysis teams, making sure everything hums along smoothly.

You’ll represent the Community department at ExCom, keep communication flowing between teams, and help shape the strategic direction of Kiwiburn.

If you’re passionate about creating safe, collaborative spaces and want to be at the coalface making a real difference, this role puts you right where the magic happens.

[Apply now](https://airtable.com/appDlV9Elu7XhmaZJ/shr2eJ5RGE2AdDMOO)

[Read the job description](https://kiwiburn.com/wp-json/role-jds/v1/recmhXwyPIG9NygFx/Community+Facilitator)

### [Traffic Team — STMS-A](https://kiwiburn.com/wp-json/role-jds/v1/recLVZQlchJEIdSr7/Traffic+STMS-A)

If you love turning controlled chaos into smooth flow and keeping people safe, this role is for you. As an STMS-A, you help bring Kiwiburn’s Traffic Management Plan to life before, during, and after the event, and support getting it approved each year.

You _must_ have a current STMS qualification — it’s essential for keeping everything compliant and safe on the paddock.

[Apply now](https://airtable.com/appDlV9Elu7XhmaZJ/shr2eJ5RGE2AdDMOO)

[Read the job description](https://kiwiburn.com/wp-json/role-jds/v1/recLVZQlchJEIdSr7/Traffic+STMS-A)

### [Theme Camps Facilitator (Incoming for 2027)](https://kiwiburn.com/wp-json/role-jds/v1/recCGhiJh25prTd0J/Theme+Camps+Facilitator)

Theme camps are the beating heart of Kiwiburn. This role supports the humans who bring those spaces to life — guiding camp leads, smoothing logistics, and helping an eclectic mix of camps land on the paddock each year. This person will be shadowing the existing TC facilitator until post 26 burn for training & handover ready to rock the 2027 burn!

You’ll represent the department at ExCom, keep communication flowing, mentor your team leads, and help shape how theme camps evolve at Kiwiburn.

If you’re passionate about community-driven creativity and know what it takes to run a great camp, this is a front-row seat to making the magic happen.

[Apply now](https://airtable.com/appDlV9Elu7XhmaZJ/shr2eJ5RGE2AdDMOO)

[Read the job description](https://kiwiburn.com/wp-json/role-jds/v1/recCGhiJh25prTd0J/Theme+Camps+Facilitator)

### Volunteer at the Event

Want to be part of an onsite team? Can you picture yourself checking tickets at the Gate with a big welcoming smile, or greeting your fellow Burners as they arrive, or roaming around the Paddock as a Black Sheep Ranger?

Kiwiburn needs approximately 700 on-site volunteers to run, so what are you waiting for?? Sign up and experience the joy of helping others and bringing the Paddock to life.

Learn more about the different roles on the [Volunteering Information page](https://kiwiburn.com/participate/volunteer/).

Once you’ve got in idea of what you’d like to do, fill in the [application form on the Kiwiburn Portal](https://app.kiwiburn.com/onsite-volunteers). As we get close to the event, teams will be in touch.

**どちらの_入り方_で、****掘りにいく？** 気軽に楽しむなら **一般前売券** 本気で掘るなら **先行入場券** MOST POPULAR General / Advance ### 一般前売券 **¥500**TAX IN 券面価格が当日券より ¥200 安い * 10:00 入場／19:00 まで（最終入場 18:30） * 10:00から19:00まで、まるごと一日 * 小学生以下は無料で同伴できます ADMIT ONE11.15 SUN [この券を購入する](https://eplus.jp/sf/detail/4600450001-P0030001P021002?cta_placement=ticket_general_price&lp_ref=rmvgkl7clhxcc0b&click_ref=cmvgkl7cmdjld79) Early Entry ### 先行入場前売券 9:00 **¥1,000**TAX IN * 一般入場より1時間早く入れる * 目当ての店から順に回れる * 前回770名が選んだ入り方 EARLY 9:0011.15 SUN [この券を購入する](https://eplus.jp/sf/detail/4600450001-P0030001P021001?cta_placement=ticket_early_section&lp_ref=rmvgkl7clhxcc0b&click_ref=cmvgkl7cm1z8a5c) 2名分 Pair / Advance ### 前売ペアチケット **¥900**2名 / TAX IN 1名あたり ¥450 * 2名で入場できます（10:00 入場） * 一般前売券を2枚買うより券面価格が安い * 当日ペアチケットは ¥1,200（1名あたり ¥600） * 購入画面の「席種」で**前売ペアチケット**を選んでください（〈10時入場〉の受付内） ADMIT TWO11.15 SUN [この券を購入する](https://eplus.jp/sf/detail/4600450001-P0030001P021002?cta_placement=ticket_pair_section&lp_ref=rmvgkl7clhxcc0b&click_ref=cmvgkl7cmlqkxyk) * 前回 約300店舗 * 東京ビッグサイト * 2026.11.15 SUN * 小学生以下 無料 イープラスでの買い方（3ステップ） 1. **券種のボタンを押す**「9時先行入場」と「10時入場」は、イープラス上で別の受付です。買いたい方のボタンから進んでください。 2. **「次へ」→ 枚数と「席種」を選ぶ**10時入場の受付では、「席種」のプルダウンで _入場券 ¥500_ か _ペアチケット ¥900_ を選びます。 3. **イープラスにログインして購入**スマチケ（電子チケット）で発券手数料は 0円。会員登録が必要です。 公演日時2026/11/15(日) 10:00開演 ▾ 席種選択して下さい ▾ * 選択して下さい * 入場券 ¥500 * ペアチケット ¥900 枚数— ▾ 購入画面のイメージ。ここでペアチケットを選べます。 ※ 表示価格はチケット代（税込）です。**別途、販売サイト所定のシステム利用料・ 発券手数料等がかかる場合があります。**お支払い総額は購入画面でご確認ください。 ※ 掲載写真は過去開催時の様子です。出店内容・会場構成は今回と異なる場合があります。 Next Event Mark your calendar. ## **次の_「掘る日」_を、****空けておこう。** 2026年11月15日（日）、東京ビッグサイト。先行入場は9:00から、一般入場は10:00から。会場ホールや出店情報は、決まり次第このページで更新します。 FURUGI FESTIVAL® 202611.15SUN 東京ビッグサイト（東展示棟 第1・2ホール） 先行入場 9:00 ／ 一般入場 10:00 終了 19:00（最終入場 18:30） | | | | --- | --- | | Event | 古着フェス® | | Host | 一般社団法人AND BUYER | | Date | 2026年11月15日（日） | | Hours | 先行入場 9:00／一般入場 10:00
終了 19:00（最終入場 18:30） | | Venue | 東京ビッグサイト（東京国際展示場）

**はじめての****_古着フェス。_** 気になる古着がある人も、何を選べばいいか分からない人も。必要なのは、少しの好奇心だけです。 01 ### 前売券を買っておく 券面価格が当日券より200円安く設定されています。朝から回るなら、9時入場の先行入場券を。 02 ### 11.15 を予定に入れる 会場は東京ビッグサイト。広い会場を歩ける準備で、じっくり探しましょう。 03 ### 公式Instagramをフォロー 出店者・会場の続報は、公式発信で確認できます。 04 ### 見つけたら、迷わず手に取る 一期一会の古着は、次のラックには残っていないかもしれません。 The Feeling ## **「これだ」が、****あちこちにある。** 通り過ぎるだけの服はない。手に取った時から、その服の次の物語が始まる。 ![古着のラックが続く通路を歩く来場者](images/community.webp) ![山積みの古着から一着を選ぶ来場者たち](images/blue-balloons.webp) FAQ ## **よくある質問** 前売券はどこで購入できますか？ 販売開始後は、本ページの購入ボタンからイープラスの販売ページへ進んでください。販売開始日は決定次第、本ページと公式Instagramでお知らせします。 先行入場券と一般前売券の違いは何ですか？ 先行入場券は9:00から、一般前売券は10:00から入場いただけます。先行入場券は一般入場より1時間早く会場に入れる券です。 小学生以下は入場できますか？ 小学生以下のお子さまは無料でご入場いただけます。保護者の方とご一緒にお越しください。 支払い方法は何が使えますか？ 会場での支払い方法は出店者によって異なります。現金のご用意をおすすめします。 試着はできますか？ 出店者によって対応が異なります。詳細は当日、各ブースでご確認ください。 会場での撮影について 当日は広報活動の一環として会場内を撮影し、Webサイト・SNS・印刷物などに掲載する場合があります。ご来場・ご出店の皆様が撮影対象となることがありますので、あらかじめご了承ください。 再入場はできますか？ できます。入場時にお渡しするリストバンドをご提示ください。 どのくらい時間がかかりますか？ 会場規模と出店数は確定後にお知らせします。前回規模では、じっくり回る場合は半日ほどみておくと安心です。 ペットを連れて行けますか？ ペットの同伴はご遠慮いただいております。 ![ラックの間を埋める古着フェスの来場者](images/crowd.webp) ![](images/logo.webp) 2026.11.15 — TOKYO BIG SIGHT ## **次の掘る日を、****押さえておこう。** 前売券は券面価格が当日券より200円安く設定されています。 朝から本気で探すなら、9時入場の先行入場券を。 [前売券500円を購入する](https://eplus.jp/sf/detail/4600450001-P0030001P021002?cta_placement=ticket_general_final&lp_ref=rmvgkl7clhxcc0b&click_ref=cmvgkl7cmnv8grg) [公式で続報を拾う ↗](https://www.instagram.com/furugi_festival/) * 前回 約300店舗 * 東京ビッグサイト * 11.15 SUN Official Partners ![一般社団法人AND BUYER](images/organizer-andbuyer.webp) ORGANIZER ![ZOZOUSED](images/kv/logo-zozoused.svg) 協賛 / SPONSOR FURUGI FESTIVAL® / PRESENTED BY AND BUYER — [公式サイト](https://andbuyer.or.jp/furugifestival/) / [@furugi\_festival](https://www.instagram.com/furugi_festival/) / [アクセス解析について](https://furugi-fes.com/privacy) 掲載の開催情報は、公式発表に基づき更新します。古着フェス® は一般社団法人AND BUYERの登録商標です。 [10:00 ENTRY**¥500**](https://eplus.jp/sf/detail/4600450001-P0030001P021002?cta_placement=ticket_general_sticky&lp_ref=rmvgkl7clhxcc0b&click_ref=cmvgkl7cm4fykn7) [9:00 ENTRY**¥1,000**](https://eplus.jp/sf/detail/4600450001-P0030001P021001?cta_placement=ticket_early_sticky&lp_ref=rmvgkl7clhxcc0b&click_ref=cmvgkl7cmht71f0)

# Graffiato: Taupō Street Art Festival

New Zealand’s longest running annual street art festival.

**Labour Weekend, Annually.**

## About Graffiato: Taupō Street Art Festival

The first street art festival of its kind in New Zealand, Graffiato: Taupō Street Art Festival captures the diversity of mural painting practice, and what’s new and relevant in global urban culture.

Graffiato's ever-expanding portfolio of over 100 murals brings transformation, wonder and vibrancy to the urban lane ways and streets they inhabit. Even locals continue to find surprises hidden away down these charming back alleys.

### Graffiato curator: Olivia Laita

The curator for the 12th year of Graffiato: Taupo Street Art Festival is arts manager, Olivia Laita.

Equipped with a PhD in Chemistry and an ever-growing CV of curating successful installations, Olivia has been creatively and holistically managing art projects for over 12 years. Her CV includes project management of the Askew One ‘Wynyard Quarter Silos’, curator manager for the ‘Post-Graffiti Pacific’ exhibitions in Auckland and Sydney and assistant manager for SWIDT’s award winning album ‘Stoneyhunga’.

The 2024 Graffiato: Taupō Street Art Festival features a dynamic lineup of artists who will bring new vibrancy to the town's urban spaces. The participating artists are:

![](https://kiwiburn.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/ThemeCamp-hero-1.jpeg "ThemeCamp-hero-1")

# Theme Camps

![](https://kiwiburn.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/ThemeCamp-hero-1.jpeg "ThemeCamp-hero-1")

# Theme Camps

## What is a Theme Camp?

Theme Camps are an essential part of the heart and soul of Kiwiburn. They are social meeting places where anything can happen, and often does.

Featuring art and activities, Theme Camps are interactive in nature. They are a direct expression of the principles of inclusion, communal effort, participation and gifting.   

A Theme Camp is a pocket of reality created by a group of humans who get together to do something interesting. Theme Camps create an ambience, a visual presence, provide a communal space, or create and host art and activities for Kiwiburn participants. 

[Registrations](https://kiwiburn.com/participate/theme-camps/#Register)

[Sound camps](https://kiwiburn.com/participate/theme-camps/sound-camps/)

[Set up guide](https://kiwiburn.com/participate/theme-camps/theme-camp-setup-guide/)

### THEME CAMP CRITERIA

To qualify as a registered Theme Camp, you’ll need to:

*   Run at least 3 interactive events, which will be featured in the Kiwiburn Event Guide.
*   Contribute to the [10 Guiding Principles](https://kiwiburn.com/the-event/culture/guiding-principles/) of Burning Man.
*   Agree to our [Theme Camp Setup Guide](https://kiwiburn.com/participate/theme-camps/theme-camp-setup-guide/).
*   Have an open and interactive space for participants.
*   Offer distinctive art, events, or a theme.

Some theme ideas: Chill Space, Music Space, Health & Wellness, Food & Drink Space, Workshop Space, Games.

### THEME CAMP BENEFITS

By gifting the presence of a Theme Camp to the community, your team:

*   Will have your Events and Camp description featured in the Event Guide, distributed to every participant on entry.
*   Will have an allocated Theme Camp placement on site, in line with your space needs, for your camp to be set up for the week. We will also work hard to try to accomodate any other placement requests.
*   _If you are planning to build a Theme Camp and don’t register your intention, we cannot guarantee that space will be available for you to build your camp._
*   _The general camping area is a fire free zone._
*   Could be eligible for Reserve and Early Entry tickets.

# Register your Theme Camp

To access these benefits, Theme Camps need to be registered with Kiwiburn and submit some paperwork.  

### REGISTRATION PROCESS

1.  Fill out the [Theme Camp Registration Form](https://app.kiwiburn.com/theme-camps/info) _(Heads up – the form is slightly longer this year and will take around 30 minutes to complete. We recommend downloading a PDF version of the questions to prepare first)_
2.  Agree to our [Theme Camp Setup Guide](https://kiwiburn.com/participate/theme-camps/theme-camp-setup-guide/)
3.  Submit your Health and Safety Plan
4.  Register at least 3 events
5.  Have no MOOP, sound, or safety violations on record from previous events.

## KEY DATES FOR KIWIBURN 2027

#### Registration

*   **15 July** Theme Camp Registration opens
*   **23 August** Theme Camp Registration Closes (for camps wanting reserved tickets)
*   **31 August** Theme Camp Registration officially closes

#### Theme Camp Reserve Tickets

*   **15 July** Request for Theme Camp Reserve tickets open in [Theme Camp registration form](https://app.kiwiburn.com/theme-camps/info)
*   **23 August** Theme Camp Registration Closes (for camps wanting reserved tickets)
*   **20 September** Theme Camp Reserve Tickets confirmed and communicated
*   **Date TBD** Burner Profiles to complete purchase of Theme Camp Reserve Tickets

#### Health & Safety

*   **Date TBD** Health & Safety plan submissions close

#### Sound Policy

*   **Date TBD** Sound Policy updated
*   **Date TBD** Sound Leads online meeting

#### Early Entry

*   **10 October**: Early Entry & Priority Lane applications open
*   **1 November**: Early Entry & Priority Lane applications close
*   **Date TBD** EE passes allocated to Theme Camps (registration in Theme Camp application)

#### Event Guide

*   **Date TBD** Event Guide submissions close

### EARLY ENTRY

Theme Camps can also apply for Early Entry passes, of which there are a limited number available for key team members who qualify to come to site early and build your structure.

You can apply for early entry in your Theme Camp registration. To be eligible to apply, Theme Camps must be registered by 23 August 2026.

We will confirm Early Entry passes in November and you’ll need to provide to us the names of those on site early.

Early Entry tickets are very limited due to our Resource Consent requirements and are strictly enforced.

### EARLY ENTRY CRITERIA

Early entry is limited by our Resource Consent, it provides access to Theme Camps where they need to set up Structures, Sound Systems, Art, or complicated Infrastructure prior to the event commencing.

Priority is given to key members of your team and access may be granted up to 3 days prior to the event commencing.

Please let us know when you register if you need early entry, what you plan on doing and how many days and people are needed.  Health & Safety during this period is critical as it is a working site.

### THEME CAMP SETUP GUIDE

Can I serve alcoholic beverages? What can I burn at my Theme Camp? Where can I dump my rubbish? Where can I plug in Theme Camp Sound System?

For the answer to all of these great questions, see our handy-dandy [Theme Camp Setup Guide](https://kiwiburn.com/participate/theme-camps/theme-camp-setup-guide/).

### THEME CAMP WOF

For the safety of everyone on site (and our Resource Consent to run Kiwiburn in years to come!), we run a Theme Camp WOF system (previously Guidelines) that each Theme Camp will be evaluated on.

Passing this WOF is crucial to having your Theme Camp being allowed to return the following year.

More info on the WOF is to come – this will be distributed directly to Theme Camps. When it arrives, please take the time to familiarise yourself and your Theme Camp members with it.

### SOUND POLICY

What happens if I want to play it LOUDER? Where can I set up our sound system? Can I throw a sunrise psy-trance party in the forest? Who cares if our music is a little loud? What else should I know?

Luckily for you, we have the answers right here in our [Sound Policy.](https://kiwiburn.com/about/the-organisation/policies/kiwiburn-sound-policy/)

### HEALTH AND SAFETY PLAN GUIDE

Theme Camp Health and Safety Guides are live now in the portal! Log in to your account on the [Kiwiburn Portal](https://portal.kiwiburn.com/) to fill this in by (Date TBD) For any questions, please contact your Theme Camp Coordination Team.

### Have we missed something? Please [get in touch](https://kiwiburn.com/about/contact/?who=Theme%20Camps) with the Theme Camp coordinator!

## ![ABOUT](common/images/main_title_about.png)

### GO OUT CAMP/GO OUT JAMBOREEとは

全国のキャンプ場を舞台に、ヒト、モノ、そして文化と自然との出会いや発見、都会では味わえない経験ができる  
アウトドアキャンプフェスティバル。

![GOOUT](common/images/main_about_ph.png)

ファッション・アウトドア・ライフスタイルを提案する雑誌「GO OUT」が誌面から飛び出しキャンプ場という自然のど真ん中で、新しい仲間との出会いや、自然の強さと優しさを体感できる時間、様々なアイテムやアクティビティの体験をパッケージしたアウトドアフェスティバル。会場には人気アーティストのライブ、来場者による色とりどりのテント、人気ブランドの特別ブース、ボルダリング、スラックライン、キッズフィールドなどのアクティビティ、各地元の名産物が揃い、どこにもない特別な野外空間となっている。音楽、ショッピング、アクティビティ、ワークショップなど様々な遊びとともに、子どもから大人まで、自由な時間を過ごすことができる場所、それがGO OUT CAMP／JAMBOREEです。

## FESTIVAL PARTNERS

 Thanks to our generous partners for making the festival a reality.

PATAGONIA

[![Untitled design (12).png](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/9ee123_77df82ec2cd742c8aa9036af5199a09e~mv2.png/v1/crop/x_0,y_604,w_1220,h_792/fill/w_465,h_302,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/Untitled%20design%20\(12\).png)](https://www.patagonia.co.nz/)

PRESENTING SPONSOR OF ‘MOST ENVIRONMENTALLY CONSCIOUS FILM’ AWARD

Patagonia is pillar of activism in the surf and outdoor industry. They build the best products, cause no unnecessary detriment to the environment and have a lot of fun while doing it! Climate crisis is an existential threat, and every part of Patagonia’s business is implicated. We must radically reduce carbon emissions by transforming how we make our products. We must also double down on our work to help communities get off fossil fuels and protect nature, the original climate solution.

*   [![RSS](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_23,h_23,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png)](https://www.patagonia.co.nz/)

SAWMILL BREWERY

[![Untitled design (11).png](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/9ee123_4f1d6f195ae34e6bbda7e585be95890b~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_465,h_302,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/Untitled%20design%20\(11\).png)](https://www.sawmillbrewery.co.nz/)

TOUR PARTNER & PRESENTING SPONSOR OF 'BEST FILM SOUNDTRACK' AWARD

Sawmill are an independent, Kiwi owned brewery run by a small team of legends out of Matakana. They’re a socially and environmentally responsible company that are NZ's first and only B-Corp-certified brewery. On top of that, they are responsible for producing damn good brews for over 20 years!

Sawmill beers will be up for grabs at our screenings this year. They will also be sponsoring ‘Best Film Soundtrack.

*   [![RSS](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_23,h_23,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png)](https://www.sawmillbrewery.co.nz/)

YETI 

[![Untitled design (14).png](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/9ee123_f13a99ea2eda48c3a0451b86cad087b3~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_465,h_302,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/Untitled%20design%20\(14\).png)](https://nz.yeti.com/)

PRESENTING SPONSOR OF ‘PEOPLES CHOICE AWARD’

YETI Coolers was founded with a simple mission: build the cooler you’d use every day if it existed. These coolers are built for the serious outdoor enthusiast rather than for the mass-discount retailers and today are the cooler of choice for outdoor enthusiasts and backyard barbecue kings.

*   [![RSS](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_23,h_23,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png)](https://nz.yeti.com/)

SOL + SEA

[![Untitled design (15).png](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/9ee123_3f2e00713dcc428dbe85c5298309dbb1~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_465,h_302,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/Untitled%20design%20\(15\).png)](https://thesolandsea.com/)

TOUR PARTNER

NZ made, 100% natural, performance skincare and sunscreen for surfers and adventurers. Created by ocean lovers + skincare experts, our NZ made mineral sunscreen and natural skincare products harness marine bio-actives, plant-based ingredients and innovative science to restore the balance in your skin and in the earth’s skin – our environment[.](http://www.thesolandsea.com/)

*   [![RSS](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_23,h_23,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png)](https://thesolandsea.com/)

PALS

[![Untitled (1220 x 2000 px) (6).png](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/9ee123_4cb6ed2ec7a4420a81fbdeaf028437e4~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_465,h_302,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/Untitled%20\(1220%20x%202000%20px\)%20\(6\).png)](https://www.whiteclaw.com/)

TOUR PARTNER

Partying is better with Pals. That's a scientific fact. Pals have become the staple drink over the years across Aotearoa. Known for their iconic can design, crisp and fruity flavour and low-sugar ingredients, they go hand in hand with the Aotearoa beach scene!

​

Kick back at the ASFF shows, and crack an ice-cold Pals or Pals 0%! We're stoked to have this awesome Kiwi company supporting the ASFF! Yeeha!

*   [![RSS](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_23,h_23,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png)](https://drinkpals.co.nz/)

GOOD SURF NOW!

[![Untitled design (22).png](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/9ee123_29eced6a55ec4ab785bd9b6bee38686a~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_465,h_302,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/Untitled%20design%20\(22\).png)](https://www.goodsurfnow.co.nz/)

TOUR PARTNER

Good Surf Now! Get pitted or die trying! Owwwwtearoa’s frothiest independent surf report & forecasting website/app is given freely so no one is denied access to high quality tools for connecting to the joy and healing power of surfing! Get involved!

[​](https://www.goodsurfnow.co.nz/)

*   [![RSS](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_23,h_23,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png)](http://www.goodsurfnow.co.nz/)

VERDURE

[![Untitled design (17).png](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/9ee123_f80ef6e3103d4c5fbe623630618e98b2~mv2.png/v1/crop/x_0,y_604,w_1220,h_792/fill/w_465,h_302,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/Untitled%20design%20\(17\).png)](https://www.verduresurf.com/)

TOUR PARTNER

Built from a love of surfing and a belief that the products we use to enjoy the natural environment should be made from materials that don't harm the planet or the people who make them. Jack from Verdure is doing some revolutionary stuff out of his shaping bay in Lyall Bay, Wellington. Build from wood, cork and love Verdure is shaking up the game in surfboard design and we're stoked to be able to give away a fresh Verdure stick to one lucky ASFF attendee as well as the winning film director for the 'Best Kiwi Filmmaker' award.

*   [![RSS](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_23,h_23,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png)](https://www.verduresurf.com/)

SURFSHELL

[![Untitled (1220 x 2000 px) (8).png](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/9ee123_0a825a939782411fbf70246f965edb44~mv2.png/v1/crop/x_0,y_604,w_1220,h_792/fill/w_465,h_302,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/Untitled%20\(1220%20x%202000%20px\)%20\(8\).png)](https://coastlineswetsuits.co.nz/)

TOUR PARTNER

All the way from Whāingaroa, Raglan, protection never looked so good! SurfShell brings together high-performance safety features and head-turning style because you shouldn’t have to choose between the two. Surfshell is an epic new Kiwi family owned business out to keep surfing safe.

Each SurfShell combines a tough ABS shell inside with soft EVA foam cushioning, helping to protect your head from bumps and cuts in the surf, while staying lightweight and comfortable to wear. It’s all about giving you that extra layer of confidence in the water, without compromising on sun protection or style.

*   [![RSS](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_23,h_23,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/11062b_51e903a1cfde4db29817f5f3a2560cfb~mv2.png)](https://surf-shell.com/)

STICKY JOHNSON

[![Untitled design (18).png](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/9ee123_69232a8042cc4243b79f4e54db5c4bd9~mv2.png/v1/crop/x_0,y_604,w_1220,h_792/fill/w_465,h_302,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/Untitled%20design%20\(18\).png)](https://www.stickyjohnson.com/)

Sticky Johnson surf wax is the ultimate surf wax for surfers seeking superior grip and performance in any water temperature or wave conditions. # Afterburn

# Afterburn Report

Every year the Kiwiburn team puts out an Afterburn report, to keep the community up to date on all the happenings at Kiwiburn, what’s going on behind the scenes, and our plans to make the event even better.

An incredible amount of work goes in to these reports, so we’d like to thank all people involved in their preparation, for our reading pleasure.

Have a browse through the Afterburn reports below.

_Note: No Afterburn Reports for 2019 or 2022 as Kiwiburn was not held on these years._  

[![](https://kiwiburn.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/2026-afterburn-report-draft-1.png "2026-afterburn-report-draft-1")](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16sy_0nA0SigZ3mlMgx2W1kEKwzfdc9BR/view?usp=sharing)

## Afterburn Report 2026

You’ll notice it’s just a draft – that’s simply because we want your feedback. In terms of content – it’s all there! We’ve delivered the expected content, including the financials from this year and last.

So – here’s your chance to get involved. Want to capture something from the last burn? Have something you’d love to know? Speak up – and get involved. [Just let us know,](https://kiwiburn.com/about/contact/) and we’ll do our best to make it happen.

Thanks to all the team leads for your feedback! It really was a challenging burn, but reading through every single report – we can tell there is still a lot of love left for the burn!

Feel free to distribute this – it’s live on the [Kiwiburn Community Discord](https://discord.com/invite/UQmd3Ppw8j) too.
